title: Tai Ari deshita. ~Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game Nante Shinai~
description:
Kuromi Girls' Academy is a refined, elegant school that expects the very best in deportment from its young ladies. Aya got into this peerless rich-girls' institution on a scholarship, and hopes to grow as lovely as her fellow student and idol Shirayui. But Shirayui hides a terrible secret: she's a trash-talking, combo-chaining, newbie-stomping, ruthless hardcore gamer! Could a mutual indulgence in no-holds-barred video game combat grow into a deeper rapport between these two girls?

*Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, Vol. 1*

title: Ijimete Ijirarete
description:
Himeri Shishido is a tough, popular delinquent girl with high confidence in her strength.
She spends her days harassing Ui Odagiri, an otaku girl in her class, with the excuse of just "playing around".
However, something unexpected will put them into a secret relationship!
May it be Violence? Or maybe a Master & Slave relationship? Anything can happen in this bullying love story!~

title: Shimeji Simulation
description:
A surreal yet heartwarming 4-koma series about everyday life.  
  
From the author of Shoujo Shuumatsu Ryokou/Girls' Last Tour.

title: Amasaya
description: The cool, black-haired Amamiya Aoi and the blonde-haired gyaru Shiina Saya's lovestruck school days

title: Moshi, Koi ga Mieta Nara
description:
Ever since she was young, Haruno Mei has had the ability to see pink arrows that tell her which person someone loves. Following many hardships that came with this ability, Mei begins attending an all-girls' boarding school in the hopes of never getting involved with romance again. However, she discovers that her childhood friend Shirayuki Saya and her new classmate Fukatsu Rinna both have arrows pointing towards her.  
  
Official synopsis:   
"That actor and that idol are gonna get married, huh?" I've gotten tired of saying that every time it happens since long ago, so I've stopped saying it lately.  
Haruno Mei, a girl who is able to see who is in love with who, begins her new school life…

title: Citrus
description:
Yuzuko Aihara, a high school girl whose main interests are fashion, friends and having fun, is about to get a reality check. Due to her mom's remarriage, Yuzu has transferred to a new, all-girls school that is extremely strict. Her real education is about to begin.  
  
From day one, happy-go-lucky Yuzu makes enemies, namely the beautiful yet stern student council president Mei. So what happens when a dejected Yuzu returns home and discovers the shock of her life: that Mei is actually her new step-sister who has come to live with her? Even more surprising, when Mei catches Yuzu off-guard and kisses her out of the blue, what does it all mean?

title: Kusanagi-sensei Is Being Tested
description: 15 years ago, Kusanagi-sensei gave up her love (♀). Now, her lost love's daughter is her student?! As she wavers under the pressure of her student's relentless attacks, Kusanagi-sensei's (♀/36) era of trial begins!

title: Kimi ga Hoeru Tame no Uta wo,
description: Oogami Haru, a high schooler troubled by her childish appearance and contrasting deep voice secretly uploads videos of herself singing on the internet. One day, when her classmate Narumiya Yuu finds out about this, instead of the ridicule she expected, Yuu instead invites Haru to form their own musical group...

title: Inkya Gyaru demo Ikigaritai!
description: Ichiko and Kuran are members of the subculture research club. They like various subcultures and they like cute stuff. Read along as these two asocial gyaru spend their days in their new kind of "youthful moratorium."

title: Osananajimi no Ijou Kawaii Imouto-chan
description: Yanagi, a second-year high school student, has a faint crush on Mizuki, the younger sister of her childhood friend Momo. One day, while rummaging through Mizuki's personal belongings in her room, Yanagi discovers the truth about Mizuki...?

title: Jīntiān de tā yěshì rúcǐ kě'ài
description: As the top freshman at Brilliant Minds High, Sadie Cang is surrounded by students who admire her brilliance, yet she lacks a single real friend. Fellow student Lex Qi has long since accepted her own hopeless, "dead last" title, along with everyone’s aversion to her seemingly contagious tendency to fail. Although they were both prepared to go through high school in these lonely roles, a silly rumor forced them together. Will an imperfect pairing form the perfect bond they never knew they wanted?

title: Real demo Shiawase ni Shitekudasai ne?
description:
Machino, một nữ sinh trung học luôn khao khát tìm kiếm “tình yêu định mệnh”, tình cờ bắt gặp trò chơi mô phỏng hẹn hò mang tên Celestia.
Dù đã đạt mức thiện cảm tối đa với tất cả các nữ chính trong game, cô lại không thể chọn chỉ một người, khiến bản thân rơi vào trạng thái dằn vặt, không thể bước tới sự kiện tỏ tình.

Đúng vào lúc ấy, một vụ nổ xảy ra cùng với sự xuất hiện của một ngôi sao băng lướt qua nhà cô. Khi tỉnh dậy, Machino đối mặt với một cảnh tượng không thể tin được, cô đang ở trước mặt Sofia, một trong những nữ chính của Celestia…
“Machino… Mình luôn muốn nói điều này… Mình thích cậu.”

title: Futsuu to Bakemono
description:
Itou-san, một người vốn cực kỳ kém trong việc giao tiếp, luôn thầm ghen tị với Takahashi-san — cô bạn cùng lớp tuy trầm tính nhưng lại hòa đồng với tất cả mọi người.

Một ngày nọ, Itou-san tận mắt chứng kiến cảnh Takahashi-san nuốt chửng một con người. Hóa ra, Takahashi-san lại là một con quái vật đội lốt người!

Một con quái vật đáng sợ lại có thể bình thản hòa nhập vào lớp học ―― Thật đáng ngưỡng mộ làm sao!! Mình nhất định phải kết bạn với Takahashi-san mới được!!

Thế là Itou-san quyết định theo học những lẽ "bình thường" của xã hội loài người từ con quái vật Takahashi-san. Tuy nhiên, trong khi Itou-san đang vui sướng ngất ngây, thì Takahashi-san lại đang nung nấu một ý đồ khác...

title: Jussai no Saikyou Madoushi
description: Ten-year-old girl Ferris works as a slave in the magic stone mine. Her daily work is harsh, and her appearance is poor, but she never fails to smile. One day, unidentified magicians destroy the magic stone mine, and Ferris is the only one who survives. In her escape, she encounters a beautiful young lady named Alicia. Ferris, in a desperate frenzy, rescues Alicia, who is about to be kidnapped by a suspicious person. In gratitude, Ferris is invited to Alicia’s mansion, where her magical talent is discovered.

title: Shy na Ano Ko ni Natsukaretai
description:
"Bạn cùng bàn của tôi, Shiraishi-san, đáng yêu quá mức… khiến tôi phát điên!"

Họ biết nhau, nhưng không hẳn là bạn bè. Akaogi Ayame và Shiraishi Konomi chỉ là bạn cùng lớp—không hơn, không kém. Ayame nổi bật với vẻ ngoài xinh đẹp, tài năng thể thao và được bạn bè yêu mến, trong khi Konomi lại nhút nhát, hướng nội và chỉ có một người bạn duy nhất. Họ vốn chẳng có lý do gì để tiếp xúc… vậy mà mọi chuyện lại thành ra thế này? Một sự việc nhỏ nhặt đã khiến những cảm xúc giấu kín của Ayame trào dâng, và giờ đây cô ấy không thể ngừng nghĩ về cô ấy!

title: Futaribeya: A Room for Two
description: About to start her first year of high school, Sakurako Kawawa settles into her new lodgings. But when she meets her new roommate -- the beautiful Kasumi Yamabuki -- everything changes! From day one the responsible, level-headed Sakurako and lazy, easygoing Kasumi find themselves at odds with one another, but with their matching mugs and one bed to share, Sakurako and Kasumi's friendship is just beginning!

title: Ishuzoku Joshi ni Marumaru Suru Hanashi
description: The only human student at an all-girl school is on a mission to sexually harass each of the monster girls.

title: Koushin Koinu ni Koibumi wo
description:
The stage is a modern school that fosters female officers, "Girl's Only Army School".  
A girl, Indou Shinobu, who came out from the countryside, meets Kagami a high-class senior student.  
Contrary to her high-handed attitude, Kagami occasionally shows kindness to Indou.

title: Chotto Mune ga Dekakute Kao ga Ii Ko
description: Morishima decides to confront a couple of girls that are gossiping about her.

title: Ouji-sama Nante Iranai
description:
Yukino Suzushiro is a freshman who belongs to the Shakuyaku 'peasant' girls division at the class-based, segregation-enforcing Douwa All-Girls High School. After the entrance ceremony, she enters a greenhouse where she finds a gorgeous sleeping girl, Nobara Himezaki, who belongs to the Botan 'rich' girls school division. After Nobara bravely fends off a pervert intruder, Yukino doesn't meet Nobara again until the dorm room partners are shuffled, and she ends up being the only Shakuyaku girl in a Botan floor, with a Botan roomie… Nobara herself.  
  
Though starkly different, as Yukino is very dutiful and friendly, while Nobara is eccentric and quiet, the two girls find themselves becoming increasingly close to one another.

title: Otome no Teikoku
description: A peek into the "everyday nudity" of high school girls. Virgins’ Empire is a look into the lives of seven high school girls attending an all girls school. We follow them as they grow relationships with one another. Some more intimate than others.

title: Kuzu Rouninsei, Jinsei ga Tsurai no de Yoru no Onee-san wo Yondemita
description: Makino failed her college entrance exam. Her only comfort is in her 2D game characters... until she found an ad for a call-girl who looked exactly like her favorite in-game waifu! The yuri love comedy between a gullible young woman and a street-wise call-girl begins now!

title: Seiyuu Radio no Ura Omote
description: Yugure Yuhi and Utatane Yasumi, two high schooler voice actresses who just happened to attend the same school and coincidentally got placed into the same class, are the two hosts of a radio weekly program. As fellow classmates and voice actresses, they show all the listeners their great friendship! At least, on the surface. In reality, the quiet girl Chika and the gyaru Yumiko are complete opposites. And they absolutely cannot stand each other. Off air, chaos and insults erupt. On air, they're the best of friends. Just where will this tumultuous relationship lead them?

title: Kamiina Botan, Yoeru Sugata wa Yuri no Hana
description:
Kamiina Botan is a 20-year-old college student. At the welcome party for the dorm she was assigned to, the dorm leader Ibuki gives her a highball to drink and she becomes tipsy, leading to her involvement with Ibuki from now on...
___
Official Manga Twitter: [@Kamiina Botan](https://twitter.com/kamiinabotan)

title: Ano Koro no Aoi Hoshi
description: Koumoto Umi, a normal high school girl, falls in love with the pretty girl from the class next door, Segawa Shou. Even though she feels overwhelmed by her feelings, she can't help but want to get closer to the mysterious Shou.

title: Shēnwéi Èyì Nǚpèi de Wǒ Yǎngchéng Bìngjiāo Nǚzhǔ Hěn Zhèngcháng ba?!
description:
Jiang Yang was a lead designer for a popular game company until she fell to her death while gathering inspiration for a new game. After waking up in a world of cultivation, she trained tirelessly to return to her original world, when a thread of fate pulled her into the world of an otome game.

Jiang Yang quickly realizes she is in the world of the very first game she had worked on. The thread of fate connected her to Stardew, the heroine of the game who is being bullied during her first year at the Royal Academy of Magic.

As the game progresses, Jiang Yang remembers the ridiculous story the game follows, and she decides that she can’t stand by while the game makes Stardew suffer. She helps Stardew deal with the flirtatious love interest of the original game, Crown Prince Miller, and even imparts her with some of her cultivation power. To protect Stardew from the game’s story, she even puts herself in danger. However, as Jiang Yang and Stardew’s relationship becomes closer, Jiang Yang

title: Dame Inu Kanojo
description: Kuramochi Sakurako has become totally sophisticated since her high school debut. However, deep down inside, she still bears the scars of being dumped by a girl she used to like. One day after school, while walking downtown, Sakurako bumps into a random high school girl who turns out to be the very same girl who dumped her in the past! What's more, for some reason, that girl doesn't recognize her and falls in love with her at first sight and asked if they could meet again. Sakurako is furious at that girl for trying to pick her up based only on her appearance and comes up with a plan to get revenge...!

title: Protagonist x Rival (Webcomic)
description:
***“Don't you DARE try to get close to Mizushima-kun!”***  
  
Kimura-san wants to get close to her crush Mizushima-kun, but the beautiful and confrontational Hiyama-san has a problem with that… though it's not the kind of problem you'd expect from this scenario.  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/kuu_u_)

title: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Darenimo Ienai
description: Chiaka là 1 đứa con nhà người ta, đẹp trai, học giỏi, có chân giữa dài 20 cm nhưng mỗi tội ế. 1 ngày đẹp trời cậu ta tỉnh dậy và phát hiện bản thân đã biến thành con gái !!

title: Dokyuusei no Oshi Sakka ni Yuri Mousou ga Bareta Kekka
description: What happens when a classmate finds out about another girl's secret yuri obsession/feelings? A yuri comedy ensues!

title: Boyish Girl × Gyaru
description: A boyish girl and a gyaru are dating.

title: Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu!
description: Hime is a girl who has developed her cuteness as a deliberate act with the plan of marrying a billionaire. One day, she is more or less forced to work as a replacement for a girl injured by bumping into her in the street. The place of work is a concept cafe where the waitresses put on a show as though the cafe were run by the yuri cliche ojousama school. There's a large contrast between the performances and the off-duty staff.

title: Yukidoke to Agapanthus
description: Natsuki, the prince of an all-girls school meets an innocent (girl) transfer student, Shun, who doesn't treat Natsuki like a prince, but instead treats her as a "friend." Natsuki excels in everything she does and even has a fan club at school. Even though she was looked at with admiration, her days were somehow unfulfilled... Although Natsuki feels uncomfortable with her first "friend", Shun's innocent smile and bright personality make Natsuki's heart flutter...?

title: Ame Demo Hare Demo
description: Country-born Mikoto and student council member Ren have always spent their time after school together. But one day, that ordinary routine suddenly comes to an end… With Uchouten High School as the stage, the love and youth of these impressionable young girls is about to begin!

title: Goukaku no Tame no! Yasashii Sankaku Kankei Nyuumon
description:
Middle-schooler Mayuki wants to enter Ohtomo high school to join her beloved senpai Akira. Problem is: her grades are so terrible there's no way she can make it into such a high level school.  
  
Thus her mother hires a high school girl named Rin as a private teacher to help her daughter. Seeing how the girl looks so much more mature than her, Mayuki ends up asking Rin to teach her more than just school subjects…

title: Unmei wa Yaku ni Tatanai
description: "Lần theo sợi tơ hồng, người sẽ tìm ra "định mệnh" vĩnh cửu của đời mình." Ngày nọ, thế giới xuất hiện những sợi tình duyên kết nối các cặp đôi tương lai với nhau. Tình yêu "nhờ duyên" mọc lên như nấm, dẫu vậy, vẫn có những con người ghét sợi tơ đó như nữ chính của chúng ta, Tsumugi. Nói là ghét vậy, cho tới khi chị ta được nối duyên..

title: Watashi Datte Seishun Shitai Desu yo, Hontou wa.
description:
Một nữ sinh trung học với sở thích đọc sách, học hành và thể thao đều ở mức bình thường.  Otobe Yukari, sống lặng lẽ, kín đáo và luôn tự nhủ với chính bản thân rằng: “Mình chỉ là nhân vật phụ thôi…”. 

Ở trong lớp, Yukari không hợp với Fujimi Shouko, một cô bạn luôn là trung tâm của mọi sự chú ý.  Thế nhưng, khi cả hai bất ngờ cùng tham gia ủy ban làm vườn, Shouko lại trò chuyện với Yukari một cách tự nhiên khiến Yukari đã phải lòng cô ngay tức khắc.  “Làm sao để có thể gần gũi với cậu ấy hơn nhỉ…?” Yukari trăn trở, cho đến một ngày, cô vô tình bắt gặp Shouko đang khóc vì thất tình... 

Một câu chuyện tình học đường lãng mạn, hài hước giữa cô nàng tỏa sáng và cô gái mờ nhạt, mở đầu cho một tương lai đầy thử thách!

title: Bokura no Ai wa Kimochi Warui
description:
Ai trong chúng ta cũng đang che giấu một “bí mật”.

Azuki Komugi là người bị ám ảnh về cô bạn gái thời trung học Meguru-chan của mình. Cô ấy nặn ra những cơ thể của Meguru từ đất sét. Một ngày nọ, Azuki đã đánh rơi “Meguru” tại nơi làm thêm, thế nên cổ quyết định lấy lại tình yêu. Tuy nhiên, ai mà ngờ em nữ sinh đồng nghiệp Yakou Remu lại đang làm gì đó với mô hình Meguru của Azuki. Muốn biết bả làm gì với nhỏ mô hình thì theo dõi là bít thui nè.

title: Ienai Himitsu No Aishikata (Magazine)
description:
Highschool teacher Saeki Nao is secretly a hardcore otaku who loves yuri manga.
One day, at a doujinshi convention they participate in, Nao is eager to convey her feelings to "Nyapoleon", an artist she worships.
However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Kurumizawa Haruka, and moreover, she had to help her.
After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion….
When she wakes up in the morning, there is Haruka in the bed…?!

title: Mikoto to Rei
description:
"Hey, Rei. Your hickey's showing, you know...?"

A story about a free-spirited gyaru, Mikoto, and a serious disciplinary committee member Rei. What will Rei do about Mikoto's teasing? Well, she's not completely against it...

(Kadokawa, translated)

title: Shouraiteki ni Shinde Kure
description: A girl tries to "buy" her female classmate with money.

title: Amaesasete Hinamori-san!
description:
Ichigo Hinamori has always looked up to her senpai Yaya Suou for her poise, impeccable grades, and kind heart. But that all changes the day Ichigo stumbles upon Yaya wailing like a little kid in the nurse’s office. It turns out everyone’s favorite honor student is desperate to get off her pedestal and be spoiled rotten instead—and now she’s hoping Ichigo will be the one to indulge her!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

___
Suou Yaya is admired by the whole school. Perfect grades, beautiful, an exemplary girl overall worthy of the praise she receives. From afar, her childish underclassman Hinamori Ichigo yearns to be like her...

...That is, until she finds her beloved Suou-senpai is a LOT more childish than her, and wants to be spoiled rotten, lest she'll throw a tantrum.

title: Zettai Watashi no Koto Suki Daro
description: Sayaka's friend, Mako, is a bit weird. And she's totally in love with Sayaka. Or maybe not?

title: Hello, Melancholic!
description: Asano Minato is hiding in plain sight. She’s tall, but she’s very quiet, and very withdrawn. She keeps her hair over her face and her head down. It’s not hard to see that she’s avoiding being seen. While eating lunch alone in her secret spot, she hears what is obviously an instrument. She immediately wonders why, since this high school doesn’t have a band. She knows that…because that’s why she transferred here.

title: The Villainess and Miss Demon Lord
description:
Two girls, hand-in-hand, cross over to another world, into a magical academy set in a melodramatic Western fantasy novel. They transform into two people completely unrecognizable to each other: One is a rich villainess who is incapable of using any kind of magic, while the other is a young girl extremely talented in the field of magic, who's said to be the reincarnation of the Demon Lord. Originally set to save the world, the two of them unexpectedly fall in love.

"Male lead, female lead, may you two live a long and happy life together, forever. I, the villainess, am going to elope with Miss Demon Lord!"

title: Yuru Yuri
description:
-  Note: Tuy có tag Yuri nhưng truyện rất hài cốt, ai từng xem anime chắc cũng biết!
 -  Tóm Tắt: Bốn cô gái nghịch ngợm đã “chiếm dụng” lại phòng câu lạc bộ Trà đạo cũ để lập ra "Câu lạc bộ Giải trí" – một nơi không có mục đích cụ thể, chỉ để tụ họp và vui chơi. Dù đã bị Hội học sinh nhiều lần nhắc nhở, họ vẫn cứ ung dung ở lại, không màng luật lệ. Trong bộ truyện nhẹ nhàng, hài hước này, bốn cô bé tinh ranh mãnh này sẽ cùng nhau trải qua những ngày thường nhật với đủ thứ chuyện linh tinh, dễ thương và đầy tiếng cười!

title: Gyaru to Otaku wa Wakari Aenai.
description:
Saotome is the top Gyaru in class - she's loud, known by everyone, and stylish. Otonashi, on the other hand, is the complete opposite. These two carry their own baggage that would ruin their built up identities… but what happens if they were to discover each other's secret?  
  
Read now to see the humorous life of how they do their best to avoid spilling the other's secret!

title: Soulmate
description: Two girls are friends, "sisters," and soulmates. Yu Qi, a 17-year-old high school student, wakes up to find that she and her 27-year-old self had switched souls. One has to relive the experience of meeting her lover again and the other has to bear the responsibility of being a girlfriend, despite being unfamiliar with the girl she's dating. Both worlds are always changing, but the only one who never changes is… you, who is always by my side.

title: Kao dake yoi Classmate ga, Yatara to Guigui Kuru Yuri no Hanashi.
description:
Kaido Ritsu has a boyfriend, whom she is dating ー just because they're both members of the popular crowd. One summer day, as she and her boyfriend were about to celebrate their one-year anniversary, her classmate Yarai Tsuzuri sees them about to kiss and... intervenes? 

This story is about an ordinary high school girl falling in love with another high school girl who is energetic, kind, outgoing, and beautiful, too.

title: Odoriba ni Skirt ga naru
description:
Haruma Kiki always dreamed of doing ballroom dance as the feminine "follower" role, but as she aged she only grew taller and taller, eventually causing her to give up ever looking good in a dress or anything ladylike. Now, as a second year in high school, she specializes in the masculine "leader" role—until one day, her partner suddenly leaves her. When Toribami Michiru, a short and pretty first year, shows up wanting to join the ballroom dance club, Kiki asks her to be her new partner, but Michiru reveals that she only plays the leader role—and she wants none other than Kiki as her partner.  
  
Bimonthly serialisation in Yuri Hime.

title: Sora & Haena!
description: Sora Yoon can hardly look a person in the eye without becoming a nervous mess. So how she ended up befriending some girls by lying about having a boyfriend is beyond her! Fortunately, she ran into the boisterous and sociable — albeit dense — Haena Woo at just the right time. Together they make a deal: Haena will help Sora land a boyfriend IF she can help her make it into college! Will they stick true to their agreement… or find they want something more?

title: Koi ni Koi suru Koibito Kankei
description:
Asako Ichijou, the student council president at a prestigious girls' high school, has been racking her brain about the ladykiller Nagi Tenma. That's the sort of person Asako is, but Nagi discovers Asako has broken school rules by bringing a shoujo manga to school... Asako pleads with Nagi to keep it a secret, and Nagi reveals her condition: "Become my lover."

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

title: Happy Sugar Life
description:
High-schooler Matsuzaka Satou has a reputation for being easy, but one day her lifestyle of sleeping with one boy after another comes to an end. It happens when she meets the child Shio, for whom she is convinced she feels true love for the first time. Satou may seem sweet and innocent, but there is nothing she won't do to protect their life together, including committing murder. But from where did she acquire the little girl, and how long can their "Happy Sugar Life" together last?

*Note: Includes extra chapters and the oneshot "White Sugar Garden, Black Salt Cage"*

title: Yuugai Shitei Doukyuusei
description: Yatsuhashi Miyako is a diligent class rep while the girl who sits next to her, Miyakonojou Reika, was discovered to not be wearing panties. Will Miyako be able to reform Reika into a normal high school girl?!

title: 1 x ½: Ichi to Nibun no Ichi
description:
Asuka Mori is infatuated with a certain someone. Trouble is that certain someone actually being the person who makes up half of her DNA: 
her mother Ayako.

title: Bad Girl
description:
The daily life of a (self-proclaimed) high school delinquent, fangirling and kohyuuing over the head prefect!?

(to) kohyuu (v. infinitive form) When one is surprised and excited, their breathing begins to kohyuu. (see: hyperventilation)

Summary: High school first-year Yuu is an ardent admirer of Head Prefect Atori, and in order to get her attention, Yuu begins to act like a delinquent. But while her intention is to appeal with her "badness" and "coolness," her simple-minded facade is seen through by Atori, who teases and treats her like a small animal...!?

*Source: Comic Fuz, edited*

title: Osananajimi wa, Nyaa to Naite Skirt no Naka
description: Trong thị trấn Miyakecho, nơi những chú mèo len lỏi khắp từng con ngõ nhỏ, người ta truyền tai nhau một lời đồn kỳ lạ: đôi khi, mèo có thể gieo lời nguyền lên con người. Ichika và Maki từng là đôi bạn thân thuở nhỏ, nhưng một biến cố đã khiến cả hai dần xa cách. Cho đến một ngày, khi Maki lao đến cứu một con mèo trắng bí ẩn khỏi bị xe tông, cô bất ngờ rơi vào vòng xoáy của một lời nguyền. Giờ đây, người duy nhất có thể giúp cô hóa giải lại chính là Ichika – người bạn mà cô từng đánh mất.

title: Ojou-sama wa Love Come no Shujinkou ni naritai!
description:
Tsubaki Saionji is a second-year high school girl. Despite her grace and elegance, she hides an embarrassing secret - she absolutely loves mindless ecchi harem love comedies, and always wants to be in the protagonist’s shoes.  
  
The irony of it all? Without realizing it, she already is a harem protagonist….

title: I Want to Be Called a Vampire!
description: Aoi wants to go to the same school as her childhood friend Yuuna so she transfers to Vlad Academy, but everyone except Aoi is actually a vampire!?

title: The Whole of Humanity Has Gone Yuri Except for Me
description: This world somehow changed and isn't normal anymore… There's no boys to be found, and all the girls have become…

title: Magical Girl Site
description:
Asagiri Aya is a young girl who has fallen victim to bullies at her school. Looking for a way to escape her troubles, she looks to the internet for distraction, when a mysterious website called “Magical Girl Site” appears. Simply viewing the page is all it takes to hurtle Aya headlong into the deadly world of the Magical Girl Apocalypse. There, it’s fight or die, against a seemingly endless array of savagely adorable, frilly-skirted killing machines, each armed with magical powers and an unquenchable thirst for blood and chaos.

(Source: Seven Seas)

title: Himawari-san
description: The development of a gentle, warm relationship between a bookstore owner and a high school student.

title: Hajimete desu wa!: Okumi Ojousama wa Hinako-chan o Beta Homeru
description:
"Your lunch, Shimoya-san? Pathetic~!"

Poor high school girl Hinako Shimoya lives in poverty and is left all alone in class because of it. But when the ultra-rich heiress Okumi Kanamori takes a bite of Hinako's homemade lunch, her delighted cry of "This is my first time~!" echoes through the room. A clash of poverty and privilege— as the two girls share more and more "first times" together, a friendship that money can't buy begins to blossom in this offbeat school comedy.

Source: Comipo (Translated)

title: Oya ga Urusai node Kouhai (♀) to Gisou Kekkon Shitemita
description:
Morimoto is getting bugged by her parents to marry (a guy). Her (female) kouhai suggests she fake her marriage so her parents would stop but they will scrutinize every guy she might choose no matter what. Since there's a new law that allows homosexuals to marry, her kouhai suggests herself; only this kouhai has confessed to her before. What will become of their married life?  
  
Incluedes additional oneshot: Anaerobic Love  
Your back is always facing me. I'm watching you way up close.

title: Namekawa-san Won't Be Bullied (Pre-Serialization)
description: A bullied middle school girl makes her highschool debut as a delinquent! But then she catches the eye of the head of the disciplinary committee…

title: Chou Shin-Uchuu Yori Ai wo Komete
description: Teradate Ten không thích dính dáng đến người khác nên chẳng xem TV cũng chẳng xem điện thoại. Thế nên cô là người cuối cùng biết rằng không những có một chiếc UFO hạ cánh xuống Trái Đất, mà vị khách ngoài hành tinh tên Lulucielamo Mocophishim Klasslamonira còn chuyển đến trường cô và chọn cô làm vợ!

title: Ane ni Naritai Ane VS Yuri ni Naritai Imouto
description: Một ngày nọ, Shio-chan về đến nhà và phát hiện ra rằng mẹ cô đã tái hôn và dự định sẽ đi công tác với chồng mới, để lại Shio-chan với em gái mới, Kafka-chan. Chỉ hơn Kafka-chan một ngày, Shio-chan lo ngại Kafka-chan sẽ cố gắng chiếm lấy vị trí chị cả của cô. Mặt khác, Kafka-chan quyết tâm khiến Shio-chan, mối tình đầu của cô, phải lòng cô.

title: Senpai ga Oyobidesu!
description:
One day, Yoriko Souma comes across the school Madonna, student council president Urushijima Kinako, collapsed from hunger. This event leads to a strange relationship between them that when Kinako finds herself in trouble, she only needs to blow on a dog whistle for Yoriko to come to her aid.  
  
[Author's twitter](https://twitter.com/omu001)

title: Baka ni Kokuhaku
description: Ayumu Otsuki is a space lover with an ambitious dream—to meet an alien. Despite lacking friends or romantic experience, she started the Astronomy Association by herself, which is the only place where she feels she belongs. One day after school, she dropped an association poster, but an upperclassman picked it up for her. The upperclassman introduced herself as Hayami, and Ayumu completely fell in love at first sight when Hayami recognized her passion! Ayumu's mind is now filled with love, and she goes all out to share her feelings. However, Senpai seems to already adore something else. She fell for a fitness junkie?! A peculiar girl's straightforward romcom!!

title: Ikemen Sugidesu Shiki-senpai!
description: A high school freshman bumps into a cool and beautiful upperclassman and falls in love at first sight. Upon seeing her at the Basketball Club, she fumbles her confession and the upperclassman takes it as her wanting to join the club.

title: Our Wonderful Days
description:
"Let's stick together from now on, in high school!"   
  
Taking place in the rural countryside of Japan, Koharu's excited to begin high school life along with her friends Minori and Nanaya. To her surprise, a beautiful girl who just moved from Tokyo is also in their class! Unbeknownst to her, Koharu is soon to be reunited with an old friend. Are these girls' feelings for each other just that of regular old friendship? Or perhaps is there something more? Cherry blossoms, convenience stores, homework, clubs, tests and chores. Normal and wonderful days lies ahead!  
  


---

title: Medetai Sensei
description:
Tachibana Mami, a very petite 29 year old P.E. teacher, was out for a run underneath the cherry trees when she slips and falls and sprains her foot. A tall, beautiful, mature woman was passing by and saw what happened. Thinking Mami was a kid, she princess carries her to to her house. Afterward, Mami can't stop thinking about what happened.

A few days later when Mami is preparing for her classes before school starts for the year, a new teacher is introduced. It turns out that Sakurai Shouko, the new teacher is the same woman who carried her home the other day. 

Shouko ends up getting way too close to Mami, and it seems to be getting troublesome for poor Mami.

title: Datenshi Soprano-chan no Fukushuu
description: Back in sixth grade, Mirei hurt her best friend Soprano with heartless words after she confessed to her. Five years later, Soprano, now a famous model, transfers to Mirei's high school. While Mirei hopes to reconcile with Soprano and go back to being friends with her, friendship isn't what's on Soprano's mind.

title: Himenospia
description: Abused like a slave by everyone at school, and battered by the single mother she lives with at home… That was the girl’s, Endou Himeno’s, everyday life. However one day a ‘wasp’ that stung the girl changed her fate. Her fate, and that of humanity… Piercing the ‘species’ known as humanity, a thrilling insect suspense story begins!

title: Cylcia=Code
description: Kanata and his friends must find a way to return to their original bodies after they're trapped in the real world as their game avatars.

title: Hoshikuzu Telepath
description: Umika is a very shy girl who has always been very bad at communicating with others. Over time she gave up on making any friends, until one day she meets the transfer student Yuu. Yuu claims to be an alien with the power of "Foreheadelepathy" - being able to read people's emotions by pressing her forehead to theirs.

title: Namekawa-san Won't Take a Licking!
description: After putting up with years of bullying in junior high, Namekawa-san decides to make a preemptive strike when she starts high school. Her plan? Become a delinquent! At first, everything seems to be going great—her classmates are terrified. However, the head of the disciplinary committee is unfazed. She’s got her eye on Namekawa-san, and she refuses to look away in this explosive yuri comedy!

title: Yuri SM de Futari no Kimochi wa Tsunagarimasu ka?
description: Mio has to temporarily live with her former childhood friend Sarasa for a couple of weeks. When she opened their living room door, she saw…

title: Sankakkei no Kowashi-kata
description: Koto, Aya, and Erika were secretly in love with each other. Koto's thoughts reach Aya for a short while, but Aya disappears as if she had been spirited away. Seven years later, however, Aya appears to Koto and Erika as she was then...

title: Yuriota ni Yuri wa Gohatto Desu!?
description: Watanabe Fuyu is a diehard fan of yuri, so she studied hard to get into an all-girls private school and quietly observe the S-class setting of her fantasies. At first, it seems like heaven… until she meets Yoshiokari Rika, a cheery gyaru who reads more like an otaku's dream girl than the refined, demure ladies she's used to reading about. Thrown off by the outlier, Fuyu is reluctant to become friends with Rika - and with their clashing archetypes, she's hoping this odd couple doesn't graduate into a rarepair.

title: Katenai Ko
description: Two female classmates engage in a playful game challenge involving games such as poker, shogi etc... with the loser forced to fulfill embarrassing requests. Confident at first, one girl quickly loses each round, leading to increasingly awkward and funny situations.

title: Girl Friends
description: Mari is a shy, studious girl who has neither a boyfriend nor any friends. One day, Akiko - one of the most fashion-conscious and sociable girls in the class - strikes up a conversation with her out of the blue! As the days go by the two become inseparable, with Akiko often cheerily remarking on how they became best friends so easily. Mari has a lot of fun with Akiko and her group, slowly becoming more outgoing despite still being timid and awkward. But she knows, deep down inside, that she doesn't want them to stay just friends forever…

title: Oddman 11
description:
There're 11 kids in Setsu's school who have special quirks and characteristics, called Oddman. Setsu wanted to date the only male Oddman, Itami, and so she proceeded to challenge all other Oddman since they were his ex-girlfriends. In the process, she made several Oddman fall for her instead.  
  
Originally published bimonthly in Comic Megastore Alpha, then Comic Hotmilk (both hentai magazines).

title: Saki
description: Saki's never been a big fan of mahjong. A lifetime of being forced to play with family at holidays (and losing her money as a consequence...) has left a foul taste for the game in her mouth. When she's convinced, though, to play a game with her classmates, she discovers that not only has fending off her family left her with an uncanny ability for the game but, more surprisingly, that it can even be fun! Is this revelation enough to cleanse Saki's distaste for the game? Can her classmates convince her to join their club, or is there just too much baggage to make it worth her while?

title: 30-sai made Doutei de Itara Mahou Shoujo ni Narimashita
description:
"When you are a virgin until you are 30, you will become a wizard." A famous joke around the Internet… is what I thought, but to think that it actually happened to me!

Wait, but this isn't a wizard? Eh? Magical girl? Why?

Comedy manga about magical girls who used to be old virgin guys!

---

[Alternative Niconico raws](https://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/39350)

title: The Yandere Sister Just Wants Me to Bully Her
description:
The protagonist, who is a novelist, deeply detests women who appear innocent and pure but are manipulative, so she intentionally creates such a main character in her book and arranges for her to be mistreated repeatedly! However, she never imagined that one day she would end up transported into the book, and now she is determined to take personal revenge! But due to her tendency to fall in love with beauty, she cannot bring herself to harm the beautiful, innocent protagonist and, step by step, ends up becoming her guardian... While she is anxious about her misguided feelings, the ever-fragile protagonist pushes the male protagonist three meters away and confesses his love for Gu Xing in a stubborn way! What! So, after all, I'm the one being protected!

Source : MU

title: Haikei, Arishi Hi ni Saku Hanatachi e
description: Kasumi, a serious girl who has just started at an all-girls school, discovers a letter tucked into an old book she found in the library. The letter's writer yearns to have a special relationship with another girl, like how it was described in the book… A romance about the the old-school "S" kind of girls-love.

title: Watashi Dake ga Miyaji Miyuki wo Aishiteiru
description:
Miyaji Miyuki (16) moved away when she was little, not long after going on a spree of proposing to several different girls in kindergarten.

Years later, she returns to her hometown and transfers to a new high school, where she is forced to reckon with her past...

title: Inugami-san to Nekoyama-san
description: About best friends Yachiyo Inugami and Suzu Nekoyama. Inugami likes cats and has a dog-like personality. Nekoyama likes dogs and has a cat-like personality.

title: She Gets Girls Every Day.
description:
Mayuzumi Kasumi is the school Idol. However, she doesn't realize this. She just wants friends, but that's difficult when she unconsciously seduces all the girls.  
  
**Links:**  
- Original Web Comic on [ [Niconico](http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/26411) | [ComicWalker](https://comic-walker.com/contents/detail/KDCW_MF06000041010000_68/) ] (Raw)  
- [Twitter](https://twitter.com/harumankai)

title: Fuzoroi no Renri - Side Stories
description:
From Newtype site:  
  
Our ages are different, our ways of life are different, everything is different. But… I just want to be with you!  
Because I've never been in a miserable, tragic romance, I can say that unrequited love is fine…  
I don't know why I fell in love with this person…it's a mystery!  
  
They have different personalities, different ages, different ways of thinking, different looks, different everything.  
This is the story of girls who clumsily make up for what's lacking in the other.  
  
T/N:  
These are side stories. Not a rewrite of the original serialized twitter comic. It builds up on what happens in the main series in a longer format. It eventually merges with the main series in the volume edition.
   
The kind of stories these are is all in the title!  
  
不揃 (fuzoroi) means uneven, irregular, but also incomplete. 連理 (renri) is "entwined relationship".  

So, these are stories of intimate relationships between "incomplete" girls that somehow complete each oth

title: Sabori nara Hokenshitsu de Douzo?
description:
"Do you want to skip class with Sensei?" 
"I'm fine!"

Miyake Mia has always worn the mask of an exemplary student. Recently, however, there is someone who draws a lot of attention to her. That's Nurse Morikubo, who is rumored to be a "delinquent" within the school....

title: Koishikawa-san Is a Carnivore
description:
Koishigawa Akane is a cute, stylish gyaru with gray hair. But she's got a glare that gives a bad impression to most of her classmates, who now keep their distance. Nishimura Chika is the only one kind to her.  
  
Creator-approved translation of chapter 1 by [TheElusiveTaco.](https://twitter.com/elusive_taco)

title: Ironna Onna no Ko to Kiss o Shiteitara, Yuri Kiss ni Mezamete Shimaimashita….
description:
One day, Higashi Kaede, a first-year high school student who loves helping people, witnesses something falling from the sky. When she went nearby, there was a "girl''!?

"You are my partner!''

Then, she asked me to do something...? There's friendship, effort, and sometimes battle!?

title: Watashi wa Succubus to Kiss wo Shita
description: 普通の女子中学生として、幼馴染のフウと平穏に暮らしていた雪子。しかし、転校生のこのみによる突然のキスによってその平穏にヒビが入る。なんとこのみはサキュバスで雪子から精気をもらおうとしていたのだが、実は雪子にも秘密があって――。

title: Komada-san wo Komarasetai
description: Komada is a short high school girl who is constantly troubled with something. Her junior, Kagai, who is big in various ways, is always playing with her and annoying Komada! However, there is a reason why Kagai annoys her, and that is simply because... The more you love someone, the more you want to annoy them!

title: Hitodzuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshi koukousei ni do hamari suru Hanashi
description:
Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish. She is a good girl, but she has had problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tried to counsel her, they somehow ended up kissing each other in bed. This is definitely an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into so much trouble that could only lead to her own destruction?

— How could I have let this happen?

title: Swap ⇔ Swap
description:
Two girls, Ichinose Haruko and Nikaido Natsuko, bump into each other by accident, resulting in a kiss that would change their lives…  
  
Placed 5th for "Best New 4-koma series of 2015" awards.

title: Oshi V ga Oshiego de Watashi ga Mama de!?
description:
Karasawa Kazuki is a university student who wants to become an art teacher, and is middle of teaching-training. However, she's bothered by her student Tsubosaki Mimi, who gets involved with her at her teaching practice.

Kazuki finds solace in watching the VTuber "Tsubomi," who is her favorite VTuber But then she finds out that Mimi is Tsubomi's true identity...! Her favorite VTuber is her student, and the artist she admires is her teacher...!

A new sensation of VTuber x Yuri romantic comedy has begun!

title: Tsubame Tip-off!
description: Tsubame is a new high school student with a complex about her height. Despite her stature, she has the persona of a small and shy girl. Also unathletic and clumsy, she seeks to join a cultural club. Enter her upperclassman, Ibis, a small girl with a big presence, who suddenly invites Tsubame to join the basketball club?!

title: Boyish na Kanojo
description:
Hime fell in love with Kazuki since the first encounter and had been dating for 6 months, but just realized that Kazuki is not a man.

[Source: MangaUpdates]

title: Lily
description: Yilin bumps into the tomboy Rouxi, sparking an interest between each other that slowly blooms.

title: Sunami Yuuko to Yuri na Hitobito
description: Sunami Yuuko is surrounded by lesbians at her school.

title: Girls × Vampire (Serialization)
description: The vampire Ruruna-sama's first kin, the high school girl Wakana, awakens to a love for her master that is stronger than Ruruna could ever imagine...!? An exciting collaboration between popular yuri authors Mikami Teren x Chigusa Minori brings a passionate girls' comedy!!

title: Sukeban to Tenkousei
description:
The strongest sukeban × air-headed transfer student!
A beautiful girls' comedy with too much happiness!

Riri Kanzaki, a transfer student, is looking forward to hanging out with Atsuko Nagumo, a sukeban, every time they play their silly word game.

As Atsuko sees Kanzaki's happiness, she begins to think that it's not so bad…
___
**Additional Links:**
- [Official X](https://twitter.com/suketen_pr)

title: Shoujo Kishidan × Knight Tale
description: Amakawa Shinobu is an ordinary schoolgirl who was about to fall prey to the clutches of a dirty old man. But she is saved by... a (real) knight in armor!? This knight, Kasugai Kanade, is a competitor in “Heavy Fight”, a knightly sport in which armor collides with armor. What will be her fate as she takes the entrance exam for St. Agrippina Girls Academy, a prestigious school for heavy fights? The knightly tale of girls clad in armor on their soft skin begins here!!

title: Seifuku no Vampiress Lord
description:
Normal high school girl Irie Yuunagi suddenly has her blood sucked by a strange man one night. Yuunagi wakes up as a vampire and learns that she has been added to the man who bit her, Rin's, family. She begins to learn about the rules of the vampire world from Rin.  
  
Other links:  
[Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/member.php?id=30738843)  
[Author's site](http://tomoki.yukishigure.com/)

title: Kidou Senshi Gundam: Suisei no Majo - Seishun Frontier
description:
Tương lai không xa, tại Học viện kĩ thuật cao cấp ASTICASSIA, Kanagawa, Nhật Bản. Một học sinh chuyển trường tên Suletta tình cờ gặp Miorine, con gái của một gia đình danh giá địa phương. Khi Miorine chưa tìm thấy ước mơ của mình, Suletta đưa ra một đề nghị:

- "Cậu có muốn giúp tớ hoàn thành danh sách những việc tớ muốn làm không?"

Hai cô gái này cùng bạn bè trải qua những ngày tháng rực rỡ, khám phá những chân trời mới!

title: Senpai Doesn't Want to Fall for Her Kouhai
description: A kouhai confesses to a senpai who doesn't want to date her. However, said senpai is more than aware of what she's dealing with…

title: Yoarashi Ni Warau
description: Class 2-C is a rough place. The students abuse their homeroom teacher, Miss Ogino, and made doing so their favorite pastime activity. Even in her hopelessness, Miss Ogino has a routine: She writes letters to the students who are not attending school. In them, she writes that her class is wonderful and full of hope. Only in these letters could Miss Ogino be an “ideal teacher”. One day though, Yoarashi, a student to which Miss Ogino was sending letters, showed up at school. She tells Ogino that she is worried that her lie will be exposed. This is where their "education" began.

title: Yagate Kimi ni Naru Koushiki Comic AnthologyBloom Into You Anthology
description:
Anthology of short stories featuring Bloom into You's characters, drawn by various yuri authors.  


---

**Vol 1**

1: Can I Bloom Into You Someday?, by Hiiragi Yutaka.  
 Touko wants to swap uniforms with Yuu, but…  
2: Perhaps A Constellation Like That, by Canno.  
 Touko and Sayaka read their horoscopes… and Yuu's.  
3: Floating Maiden, by Chomoran.  
 When romance can make you float. Literally.  
4: Onigiri, Croquette, Tamagoyaki, by Miyama Okara.  
 Koyomi has started a new novel. And she's hungry.  
5: Tiny Sempai, by tMnR.  
 Yuu becomes Touko's babysitter.  
6: In The Box, by Yuikawa Kazuno.  
 What's in Touko's box? And for whom is it? Sayaka wonders…  
7: Festival Night, by Mekimeki.   
 Touko always gives her all. Especially when there's a reward.  
8: Let's Write A Script!, by Fumio Aya.  
 The early rejected draft of the Student Council play.  
9: What Will You Wear Tomorrow?, by Yuzuhara Moke.  
 Touko wants Yuu's opinion on her new clothes.  
10: Bitter Coffee Time, by

title: Tokubetsu na Chuutohanpa
description:
What does it mean to "date" someone...

This is the story of two people.
Not quite friends,
but not quite lovers
caught in a special situationship.

title: Ano Ko ni Kiss to Shirayuri wo
description:
The parallel and indirectly connected stories of various couples in the all-girl Seiran Academy. Each volume focuses on a different one.  
  
It follows model student Shiramine Ayaka, who one day sees her top spot stolen by the lazy genius Kurosawa Yurine… and accidentally makes Yurine fall in love with her, much to her dismay; Ayaka's shy cousin Mizuki and her quirky girlfriend Moe, who met and bonded through running; or Yukina and Towako, the two members of the gardening club who forcefully recruit Yurine, among others.  
  
Often comedic, sometimes bittersweet, always light.

title: Kyou, Koshiba Aoi ni Aetara.
description: The latest manga by the creator of Masamune-Kun's Revenge. The story of Kyo, Koshiba Aoi ni Aetera follows Sahoko, a girl who values what others think of her, and Aoi, a girl who is able to let out her true self without caring about what others think. To get closer to Aoi whose candid air appeared shining, the action that Sahoko takes to get closer is… a kiss.

title: Shoujo Nyuumon
description: A new type of romantic comedy full of laughter and excitement, featuring two "boys who have turned into girls," is about to begin!

title: Heimin no Watashi desu ga Koushaku Reijou-sama o Taburakashite Ikiteimasu
description:
Lilah, a commoner, is cast out of the only home she's ever known, finding herself lost in the depths of a forest, on the brink of death. Fate, however, has other plans, as she miraculously reunites with Eva, a young lady of nobility she once played with as a child, narrowly escaping a dire end. Moreover, this encounter leads Lilah to an unexpected role as Eva's personal bodyguard. Now, she faces the ultimate challenge: can a commoner like her rise above and excel in the world of the nobility?

---
**Links:**
- [Alternative Amazon Link (Individual Chapters)](https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B0CBGWG5K2)

title: Sugar Meets Girl!
description: Satou Kanna, daughter of a yakuza boss and known for being loyal to her friends and her slightly delinquent appearance. Mochizuki Mito, class president and the school's most envied upon young lady. Just what unexpected secrets did these two girls find out about each other!?

title: Idolatry
description:
Động lực sống của nữ sinh cấp 3 Harumi Junna là được theo dõi và ủng hộ thần tượng Tsukishiro Fuwari!
Thế nhưng một ngày nọ, nhóm nhạc thần tượng mà Fuwari trực thuộc bất ngờ tan rã.
Giữa lúc đang tuyệt vọng, Junna biết được tin Fuwari sẽ tham gia một chương trình tuyển chọn idol.
Tổng cộng có 100 thí sinh, để giúp Idol của mình giành lấy vị trí cao nhất, Junna quyết định tự mình tham gia chương trình và âm thầm hành động

Cuộc sống "đu idol" liều lĩnh của cô gái otaku bắt đầu từ đây!

title: Saikyou no Youhei Shoujo no Gakuen Seikatsu
description: Cierra, a young girl who's been a skilled mercenary her whole life, decides to retire from being a mercenary and try to live like a regular school girl.  While at her new school, Cierra befriends Alna, a young noble girl who's being targeted by assassins, and vows to protect her.

title: Boku wa, Yuri na Onee-chan wo Ouen Shiteimasu
description: Mio cares about his older sister quite a bit as she's quite shy and can't do much without him. When a transfer student joins her class, he can't help but try to help her make a friend.

title: Naraku no Hanazono
description:
Mary, a girl who moved from Tokyo to the countryside, meets the mysterious girl Colin in a "secret garden" up in the mountains. With nowhere to go, they share a "secret" in the garden that they can't tell anyone. They didn't realize the consequences of what they did.......

(Source: Yuri-Hime, translated)

title: Yandere Meruko-chan wa Senpai ga Osuki
description:
I love Senpai...
I don't need anything else.
Meru thought romance wasn't for her, but then she appeared. Her "senpai" with a small frame and strong sense of justice. She fell in love at first sight, and despite constantly expressing her affection, her love runs even deeper...!?

title: Tonari no Seki no Jimi na Yatsu
description:
Kawase Sonoe ain't much to look at. Plain, serious and uninteresting, sure, but for some reason, her next-seat neighbor Mori Ichika can't stop staring at her.

Mori follows her and discovers that Kawase has an awful lot to show her, and that she'll receive from Kawase an education that she can't admit she needed.

title: Adachi to Shimamura
description: Adachi's looking for a quiet place to sit around while she's skipping class and goes to the second floor of the gym, expecting it to be empty. There she meets Shimamura, and their friendship begins.

title: Daddy's Sexy Doll
description: Born into a wealthy family, she lost her mother at a young age. She is Riona, a girl who was raised by a single father. At the girls' school she attends, she has many friends and a special partner of hers. She lives feeling a little lonely that her busy father has just left her house.One day, her father bought a robot that she said was her "housemaid". She witnessed the act of "Forty"...?A girl who wants her affection and a robot who doesn't know her feelings. A dramatic story of gems!

title: Tonari no Senpai to Kininaru Kouhai
description: Jun Hinami is a lonely freshman girl who has failed to connect with any of her classmates and hasn't made any friends. That is, until Saki Kogarashi, a scary-looking upperclassman girl reaches out and makes her join her club with the sole purpose of keeping her company.

title: Mashou no Otome no Yakumawari
description:
Học viện nữ sinh Kairan

Một trường nội trú giàu lịch sử và truyền thống, chỉ dành cho trẻ mồ côi.

Ở đấy có một hệ thống đặc biệt, trong đó sinh viên được cho những "các vai diễn" phù hợp với mục tiêu cá nhân của họ.

Hanako Shimura, một cô gái tốt bụng đầy ước mơ và kỳ vọng, ghi danh vào học viện với hy vọng kết bạn với mọi người ở trường. Nhưng cô ấy có thể làm được không?

Bộ truyện mới của Sasuke, tác giả của False Marigold và Be Careful, Onee-san.!

title: Kimi ni Okuru Eien
description: Short Kimi to Tsuzuru Utakata after story.

title: Her Mountain, Her Ocean
description:
[Gentle, tenacious honor student X cold domineering girl] 

Chi Tang and Youyu are both weirdos in Year 1 Class 2 of high school. They become desk mates, roommates, each other's salvation, protecting the other's warmth. The relationship between the two went from ignorance to understanding. A poem of youth composed.

title: This is Obviously a Yuri Manhua
description:
When the timid Wu You moves to a new high school, she quickly grows attached to her new deskmate, the gregarious Ye Yin. But there is more than meets the eye with Ye Yin, and as the days pass, Wu You's feelings begin to deepen.   
A love story between two secondary school classmates.  

Author's Lofter: [占](https://zhan6019.lofter.com/)
Author's Weibo: [@这里是占](https://www.weibo.com/u/6016748885)

title: Ore wa Koisuru Onnanoko
description:
Yuuri Onagawa is a young boy about to enter high school, who constantly pines over his childhood friend Kyouko. One day he meets her after years of separation, only to find out that she despises men now. 

Upset, he prays at a shrine to have them become friends once again. The god fulfills his wish, but in a way he never expected…

title: Daishinyuu
description: The story will center on two junior high school girls who first met in elementary school. They do not get along or like each other whatsoever. Despite that, a bond strangely develops between them.

title: Sakura Trick
description: Yuu and Haruka were inseparable during junior high but a cruel twist of fate put them on opposite sides of the class when entering senior high. Forced to spend more time with their other classmates, they decide to do something to keep their relationship special. A comedy 4koma.

title: Tayutau Koi no Chirigiwa ni
description: A girls' school, Hibiscus Academy, where only selected young women can attend. At this academy, there is a princess and a prince. The "Princess of Hibiscus," student council president Suzuran, and the "Prince of Hibiscus," vice president Emma. In public, they both play their roles as prince and princess perfectly, loved by everyone, but when they are alone, they are two trusted friends who joke around and talk naturally. However, their relationship takes a sudden turn due to a certain event. That event is... Suzuran's heartbreak.

title: Tonari no Seki ga Sukina Hito Datta Gakusei Yuri Anthology
Goreijou Takashima Kiyono wa Hisoka ni Tashinamu.
description: To Lady Takashima, the breach of etiquette is deserving of the death sentence. As the hate towards the lack of manners arises within her, the feeling of "I want to try it" has also arisen within her. This work is the record of the daily life of the Ojou-sama struggling with her guilt.

title: Aashi to Watashi. - Gal × Yuri Anthology
description: A collection of gal × yuri stories by various popular artists.

title: Ore ga... Yuri!?
description: A miraculous account of a doubter who was turned into a woman by the one true god. "If you cannot make a girl fall in love with you as a woman your punishment will be to remain a woman for the rest of her life." Thus spoke INSR-sama - the powerful holy lesbian fox goddess who rules our lives - hallowed will be thy name.

title: Oshi no Yuri o Zettai ni Jamasasenai Kishi-tachi
description:
Karen and Miyu grew closer after entering high school and ending up in the same class. As they spend more time together, they find themselves increasingly drawn to one another, and little by little, the distance between them begins to close. They start noticing each other's little gestures and habits, and even feel jealous when they see the other getting along with someone else. At times, they even wonder whether the feelings they have for each other are wrong…

But who cares what other people think?! Wanting to take their relationship one step further, the two finally gather the courage to confess their feelings to each other.

…And this is the story of the knights who, working behind the scenes, fight with everything they've got to protect the precious relationship between these two girls!

title: Yuri between a Masochist and a Sadist Who's Bad with Just Words
Hokenshitsu wa Futarikiri
description: A collection of interconnected yuri stories in the nurse's office.

title: Unicorn to Sabishi-gari ya Shoujo
description:
Perverted Unicorn likes an ultra-pure(virgin) lonely girl

---

title: Kanojo ni Naritai Kimi to Boku
description: Hime Sakuragaike has secretly been in love with her childhood friend Akira Yonezawa since they were kids, but Hime only recently found out that Akira identifies as female. Although surprised, Hime offers her full support, and this is initially kept secret between them for a few years, but Akira decides to start living as a girl full-time upon starting high school with Hime. However, since Akira garners a certain amount of attention, Hime takes it upon herself to aggressively stick up for Akira whenever necessary. Not wanting Akira to be singled out as an object of ridicule, Hime decides that her only option is to put herself in Akira's shoes.

title: Watashi wa Kimi wo Nakasetai
description: "Tears" connect people who have never met before. This is the story of an honour student and a delinquent who are connected through these tears.

title: Futari Monologue
description: Hinata is an introverted geek who sits next to Mikage, a gal, in class. Hinata realizes that Mikage is a former friend from elementary school, and attempts to rekindle their friendship.

title: Tsubaki-sama wa Sakihokore nai
description: "Be pure! Be just! Be beautiful!" That is Tsubaki's motto! She's cute and tries very hard, but sometimes she's just wide open. Aiming to be a graceful woman in the future, her ideas clash with reality!

title: Houkago Saitensei!
description: Ten years ago, a magic circle suddenly appeared above Earth, connecting it to the parallel world Alterna. This led to the invention of the Alternaphone, which allows people to freely reincarnate between worlds, allowing earthlings to become adventurers and otherworlders to become normal citizens. The series follows two amnesiac girls, earthling Kurami Utaho and otherworlder Melua Solaris, as they go back and forth between ordinary life on Earth and adventuring on Alterna.

title: A Yuri Manga Between a Delinquent and a Quiet Girl That Starts From a Misunderstanding
description: After a misplaced confession lands the letter of Touno Hitomi in the locker of Saijou Nagisa, both of them experience feelings of attraction towards each other…

title: Slow Start
description: Following an unfortunately timed case of the mumps, Hana Ichinose misses all of her high school entrance exams and ends up having to spend a gap year as a ronin. Moving to a new location and starting high school a year late, Hana becomes friends with her classmates, Eiko, Tama, and Kamuri, while keeping it a secret that she is a year older than them.

title: Sasameki Koto
description:
Sasameki Koto is the story of Murasame Sumika, an intelligent and athletically gifted girl who just happens to be in love with her best friend, Kazama Ushio. Unable to confess her feelings, Sumika can only stay by her side and watch over her. After all, the biggest obstacle to her love is something that she can't change. It has nothing to do with the fact they're both girls; Sumika just isn't Kazama's type!

Kazama is only into cute girls and Sumika's cool personality just doesn't fit the bill. Much to her friend's dismay, Kazama is always eager to share news about her latest crush. With the duo's knack for attracting trouble, it looks like Sumika's trials have only just begun.

title: Naisho no Ofutarisama.
description: Is it wrong to think about eating food all day...? Eliza, a young lady who is only interested in food is brought a delicious gift by a delinquent named Misaki. She's scary... but she can't resist the allure of good food!

title: Love-Doting Girl
description: A super rich Ojou-sama, Aiu Eiko is passionately in love with her classmate, Nagi Nagisa. The daily life of a little(?) weird high school girl.

title: Rine🐈‍⬛ to Hinano🐕
description: Daily moments between childhood friends who are secretly in love with each other.

title: Azumi-chan to Kochou-chan
description: Asumi, whose earnest nature makes her a pillar of support for everyone, is dating Kocho, the most beautiful girl in their grade. However, the one thing he realised after getting together with her was that she was actually a "queen bee" type who is utterly self-centred and totally agressive. Asumi, who finds herself constantly at Kocho’s mercy, can’t stop her heart from racing at her every word and action! But is it actually Kocho who’s getting all flustered?

title: Hisokana Hana Emi
description:
"If I were to be honest, it would have been better if I were like everyone else."  
  
Because of her eye-catching looks, there are rumors that Yohira Shino plays around with men. Thus, she is both treated as a nuisance and feared by those around her.  
  
One day, she meets Yozakura Yuui, a sophomore upperclassman who Shino remembers disliking due to the former being an honors student. Howeover, due to some circumstances, they start to live together in the same dorm room. Though Shino initially opposes, she finds that there's something about Yuui that separates her from everyone she's encountered until now.   
  
[Artist's Twitter](https://twitter.com/Yumemitsuki125)

title: Haru no Regista
description:
Once hailed as a soccer prodigy, high school girl Arai Haru transferred to a school far from her hometown, hoping to start a new life away from soccer. However, a new student, Osanai Satsuki, who admired Haru's past glory, appeared before her and declared her intention to join the Soccer Club, which is on the verge of disbandment. This is a girls' soccer story about a girl who gave up her dream and a girl who chases after it!
___
**What is a regista?**
The regista is a creative player who operates in front of the defense, almost always in a central position, and looks to get on the ball as often as possible. They are responsible for providing the link between defense and offense, and controlling the tempo of the game through their passing. The regista is also known as the deep-lying playmaker: they retain their deep position and dictate their team's play with their distribution. ([Coaches' Voice](https://www.coachesvoice.com/cv/what-is-a-regista-explained-jorginho-andrea-pirlo/))

title: Osananajimi Lesbian Giwaku
description: A collection of oneshots drawn by Majoccoid.

title: Chimidoro Ice-cream
description: Class rep Minegishi Hinata is saved from a traffic accident by the new transfer student Nagatsuki Shion, who survives the crash as it is revealed she is half-human and half-zombie. However, the impact from the crash breaks Shion's special apparatus that keeps her heart beating, and if Shion's heart stops for even a moment, she'll become a full zombie! The only way to prevent that from happening is for Hinata to get Shion's heart pounding...

title: Kimi no Tame no Curtain Call
description: Akutsu Sakura, a wallflower with no self-esteem to speak of, and Hiiragi Tsubame, a girl brimming with confidence and dignity. The meeting between these two polar opposites marks the start of their adolescence.

title: Girls × Sexual Harassment Life
description: Sawari likes to harass her childhood friend, Kiyoto. Sexually.

title: Yuri na Kataomoi-chan
description: Yuina and Maya have been friends since kindergarten. They both like each other, but they both think that their love towards the other is unrequited.

title: Uso no Tsukenai Otoshi Goro
description:
The world is plagued with the strange illness, [Voice] that affects teenagers. But when one's feeling is disrupted, a "bunshin" or a clone will appear and it will say everything you truly feel.  
However, this illness does not pose any danger to one's life. Satsuki, a 2nd year high school developed this illness during that "incident" during her junior high school. Ever since then, Sayoi became protective of Satsuki and keeps anyone from approaching her. One day, they met Hiyama, another teenage boy who has the same illness. After meeting him, the twin's relationship started to change?!

title: Kono Sankaku Love Come wa Shiawase ni Naru Gimu ga Aru.
description:
At the start of the new semester, ordinary high school student Yashiro Tenma is in the same class as the two most beautiful girls in the school, Tsubaki Reira and Sumeragi Rinka.

Reira is a cheerful and beautiful girl, and Rinka is cool and a little scary.

Tenma wants to somehow live a peaceful school life by keeping a little distance from such overwhelming beauties, but one day he finds out Rinka's forbidden secret, and the situation changes completely!?

title: Makoto-senpai no Mae de wa Kakko Tsukerarenai!
description:
Handsome girl x handsome girl!? A short love comedy set in an all-girls school!

Jun, a handsome girl character, is popular at the all-girls school.
To stay true to her character, she tries to live her life in a stylish and gentlemanly way, but whenever she's in trouble, the "true handsome girl", Makoto-senpai always appears...?
A short love comedy between two handsome girls!

title: Killing Me!
description:
To their classmates, Fujimiya Saki and Kujou Miyoko appear to get along pretty well. But the two girls have a secret: Miyoko is a vampire always thirsty for Saki’s blood, and Saki is a vampire hunter who has had enough of being teased!   
  
It’s Saki’s mission to kill vampires, but which will really enter Miyoko’s heart first – a wooden stake, or Saki’s growing affection for her?  
  
Author's twitter: [akiyamabc](https://twitter.com/akiyamabc)

title: Chasing Spica
description: Despite her gyaru appearance, Seirina Nekozuka is a serious and hard-working third-year high school student. She is trying her best to get first place in her grade to qualify for the scholarship she is aiming for, but she has been stuck in second place for years because Reiko Tachibana, the public morals officer she hates who always blames her for her flamboyant clothes, always gets first place. One day, on her way home, she sees Reiko having an affair with an unknown woman...

title: Kono Ai wo Owarasete kurenai ka
description:
Hachikawa Yuzu, một nữ sinh cấp 3 với cuộc đời học đường ảm đạm có một bí mật. Rằng thực chất cô ấy là một người hâm mộ cuồng nhiệt của Hayami Madoka, bạn cùng lớp và cũng là một nữ diễn viên nổi tiếng.
Yuzu, ngưỡng mộ và tôn sùng Madoka như một nữ thần, cảm thấy hạnh phúc khi chỉ đơn giản được học cùng lớp và nhìn ngắm Madoka mỗi ngày.
Lẽ ra chỉ như thế đã đủ, nhưng cho tới một ngày...
Một câu chuyện tình yêu méo mó nhưng đồng thời cũng vô cùng thuần khiết.

title: Koroshi Korosare Sankaku Kankei ni Watashi ga Ima kara Hairun desu ka?
description: Kohaku is a girl who spent her junior high school years as a loner and dreams of living a fulfilling life in high school. However, on her first day of school she falls down the stairs and ends up hospitalized for a month! This means that everyone besides her has already formed a group of friends at school... In order to avoid being a loner, she summons up the courage and calls out to the only odd-numbered group in her class, but it seems that they are high up in the school caste system, and are actually involved in a blood-splattered love triangle with a non-human...!

title: Eclair - Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology
description:
