title: Shoujo-tachi no Kizuato ni Kuchizuke wo
description: The girls spend their time at a school built in a deep forest. Their secret is that they are all vampires. In order to hunt without being noticed by humans, the girls are bonded by blood, and what does the "sisterhood" bring to them?

title: Hana to Hina wa Houkago
description: Hana and Hina are two high school girls working at the same character goods shop, but they are completely different from one another. Hana is petite, uncertain and shy, while Hina is tall, confident, and trendy. Yet they share a secret: their school has a strict policy against taking part-time jobs. They also discover that both of them share an irresistible attraction to things that are cute, be it the uniforms at their all-girls’ school or…each other! Just how long will Hana and Hina be able to keep their afterschool jobs, and their feelings for each other, a secret?

title: Princess of the Princess
description:
Heidi Nanzan dreams of meeting the perfect girl. So she comes to the girls school with one goal, to be a princess for her princess. At Choyuri Gakuen, it's girls as far as the eye can see.  
A no-boys-allowed yuri comedy!

title: Ii desuyo, Senpai
description:
A daily routine of relationship between Senior and Junior high school students after a kiss...

"It's okay, Senpai"

title: Liàn'ài Ràng Wǒ Yǒu le Chāonénglì
description: Art student Zhong Shenxiu encountered a problem during a sketching class. She couldn't "truly see" Xu Ke, a top student and the subject of the sketch. If she can't truly see the subject then she can't draw. Zhong Shenxiu put down her paintbrush. If she became a better student, she would be able to get closer to her, right? If she could get closer to her, then she could truly see her, right? Until the distance between them is no more--Face to face. Phew! Now I can finally see her! But! This is... Too close! Help! What Should I do?!!!

title: Oomuro-ke
description:
*A spin-off of the YuruYuri series featuring the Oomuro family of sisters!*

From oldest to youngest, there's **Nadeshiko**, the cool and serious high schooler; **Sakurako**, the silly, lazy, and (slightly) dimwitted middle schooler; and **Hanako**, the intelligent and mature elementary schooler! 

This story focuses on these three sisters, their friends. and the many fun and wild adventures they have together!

title: Toku no Takasa ga Afure Deru Ikemen Gyaru no Hanashi
Sougou Tovarisch
description: Kanna who usually enjoys being at the top of her class is outscored by one point on the first aptitude test of her high school career by the high-level kuudere/low-level dandere Yuu. Unlike Kanna, Yuu is naturally talented and couldn't care less about getting high scores, so she throws away her test immediately after after getting it. This incredibly bothers Kanna, who then in front of the class, scolds Yuu for throwing away her "symbol of how hard she worked". This gesture of kindness(??) causes Yuu to fall for Kanna. And of course, all unbeknownst to Kanna, who's all about herself anyway.

title: Falling Blue
description: Lin Ling is unfortunate in everything she does… Until the day she met Fang Wan, a kind and perfect upperclassman. She unconsciously grew attracted to her. Somewhere in the vast universe, there is always someone who is closely connected with you, and if fate allows it, you will never be alone.

title: My Stepmother Made Me Fall For Her
description: Ruan Tao, who originally wanted to dominate the entertainment world, encounters her malicious stepmother at the very beginning of her career. However, the stepmother is a great actress who dominates the world of entertainment with an iron fist. Ruan Tao can only submit and at the same time think about how to overthrow the evil stepmother's reactionary forces!As a result, she is arranged to participate in a romance reality show with her stepmother, but who is to tell her that it isn't a young love reality show with men and women courting each other? What is the plot when the stepmother holds her hand and asks with concern, fearing that she will hurt herself?

title: Otona ni Natte mo
description:
Ayano is a teacher with a steady job, a good relationship with her students and their parents, and a seemingly comfortable life - but when she runs into an attractive, charismatic woman at an old favourite bar of hers, they soon find themselves making some very rash decisions… and they may not both be being entirely honest with each other.  
  
From acclaimed mangaka Takako Shimura, a story of tangled feelings, secrets, and, frankly, just some awful human beings. You won’t want to miss this one!

title: Comic Girls
description: The story concerns the daily life of young up-and-coming mangaka living together in an all-female dormitory.

title: Project Yuriforming!
description: Yuri addict and alien Lily in search of new stimulus sets her sights on two childhood friends Iori and Runa who can't be honest about their feelings, to create "real yuri" by her own hands!

title: Yandere-chan x Negative-chan
description: Collection of one/two-pagers from the author's Twitter featuring specific characters

title: Geboku-san to Aruji-chan no Nichijou ~Aruji no Tame nara Nandemo shimasu~
description:
A sweet master-servant yuri comedy about an innocent master and a mad dog high school girl!
Satsuki, a small and innocent high school girl, and her servant named "Sato-san'' who is the strongest delinquent in the school...

title: Kounai Ren'ai
description: This school is full of relationships, with students and teachers each with their own secrets. (Source: U-NEXT, translated)

title: Pastel Love
description: "Millie" (golden haired), the perfect little girl whose life is fully equipped with everything, but because of her timeless mother, Millie has become an indifferent day-to-day person until she meets "Zen" (black-headed), an ordinary little girl whose life focussed on only studying, without Zen knowing that she herself was stirring up Millie's heart to beat again.

title: Demi Life!
description: Azuma Manaka enrolled in a school filled with demis?! She’ll be learning along them. What’s more, the inari dorm which she’ll be living in is filled with demi girls?! Surrounded by eccentric girls, her school life has just begun. Everyone is different and that’s fine. Manaka’s life with the demis is starting!

title: Todo no Tsumari no Uchouten
description: Nekozaki Ren abused her powers as school council secretary to secretly set up a Miko Club in her school’s abandoned shrine. All of this so she could spend time with her crush, Yamada Mikoto, after school. But this wasn’t meant to last. Before long some people caught wind of their little club site, and with the school’s club building fully occupied, they saw themselves fit to use the shrine for their own club activities instead! Will Ren be able to reclaim her paradise?

title: Sayuri-san no Imouto wa Tenshi
description: Sayuri's parents divorced when she was young, her father took custody of her little sister, Mikoto, and she lived with her mother. Not having seen her little sister in thirteen years, Sayuri visits the park they played at as children and finds Mikoto there. Mikoto is a pretty girl, but why does she have wings?

title: Jimi na JK ga Bishoujo ni ○○sareru Hanashi
description: Just your plain average high school girl, getting involved in yuri shenanigans.

title: Galette (Anthology)
description: Collection of Yuri Oneshots from Galette

title: Dare ni mo Ienai Futarigoto
description: The story of best friends Haruno and Chikaki who discover their feelings for each other may not be the simple, enduring friendship they assumed it to be.

title: Vacation Maou to Pet
description: A Demon Lord of another world is on vacation, searching for a precious someone… and she has finally found her! Her name is Nio, and her mother has sold her as a pet to the aforementioned Demon Lord. Follow Nio and her life living under the same roof with a Demon Lord.

title: Wasureenu Majo no Monogatari
description:
Even if today disappears, these feelings will not. An everyday in which nothing happens, with each day slightly different than the last. The slightly strange story of her, and me, and our clumsy feelings. Only I remember that there were three entrance ceremonies this year. Only I remember the unchosen days. The world, repeating 'todays' like a broken record...

"My name is Inaba Michiru. Nice to meet you."

A story about her, who befriended me the following day as well. About my first human relationship, about the gradually shrinking distance between us, and my quietly changing feelings...

title: Centaur no Nayami
description: Himeno is a sweet, shy little centaur girl. In her world, everyone seems to be a supernatural creature, and all her classmates have some kind of horns, wings, tails, halos, or other visible supernatural body part. Despite their supernatural elements, Himeno and her best friends, Nozomi and Kyoko, have a fun and mostly normal daily school life!

title: Sekai no Owari to Majo no Koi
description:
Once upon a time, witches and humans lived in harmony. However, when human society was at its lowest point, the humans blamed the witches for their misfortunes and decided to burn them at the stake. For the sake of survival, the remaining witch population allied with those who desire to take advantage of their powers.

Centuries later, after the general public had forgotten about the existence of witches, a school named Sternenlichtl was built to house and teach young witches. There, Alice Keating is a renowned witch with budding potential—having already mastered most types of magic. When new student Mari Muguruma, who has no experience with witches and magic, is transferred to the school, Alice is given the task of educating her on everything she needs to know.

Having shown no aptitude towards anything she is taught, Alice struggles to see any worth in Mari. Yet, following an emotional outburst, Mari subconsciously uses her magic on something that requires a vast amount of skill: res

title: Itazura Privacy
description:
The pretty and popular Hana bullies the plain loner Yuki in front of everyone in class. But they have a very different relationship in private.

(Source: Yuri Navi, translated)

title: Shikabane Shoujo to Ai ga Omoi Sei-kishi no Toubatsu Gakuen Life
description:
In a world where humans and fantastical creatures coexist. Shurika, a zombie, enters a boarding school where she learns to battle the "kyoujuu," creatures that threaten both races. There, for three years, the students live in pairs with members of the other race. Shurika is paired with Marie, a paladin with whom she has a certain affinity. But for some reason, Marie's affections for her is strangely overbearing...? 

Serialization began in August 2023 in Yuri Hime.

title: Watashi no Tomodachi ga Sekaiichi Kawaii
description: Saionji Koharu is an admirable student council president. A beautiful and flouncy lady that happens to always be followed around by a girl named Maria.

title: Kaiibu ~M-ken Y-shi no Kai Genshou ni Tsuite~
description:
When transfer student Sakuraba Sakura arrives in Yuuyamichou, she discovers a place steeped in bizarre, ancient customs. The children there all have strange names and are bound by a curse that prevents them from leaving the city until they graduate high school. Caught in an escalating nightmare, Sakura must navigate curses, summonings, and betrayals. To break the curse and free the children, Sakura teams up with Andou Uzu, the mysterious president of the Paranormal Club.

**Award:** KADOCOMI AWARD 2025 Lily Category 1st

title: Shinozaki-san Ki wo Ota Shika ni!
description:
With her beautiful looks and outgoing personality, Shinozaki Akina used to be the leader of a group of hotties on the top of a class hierarchy. After her high school debut was delayed, however, she finds herself isolated in the class.  
  
Next to Akina sits Sasamura Kaede, an otaku girl who can turn into a bishoujo with her glasses off. Akina decides to get Kaede out of the otaku life and groom her for a perfect high school life, but the only way to get close to Kaede is for Akina to pretend to be a Precure otaku herself to her chagrin…

title: Rororro!
description: Chitose Morishige is a 12-year-old seventh-grader without a friend in the world. Her father, Professor Morishige, built a robot companion for his daughter to ease her loneliness. The only problem is that Ichika Robata, the android, is so lifelike that Chitose believes she's a normal human girl who either ran away or was kidnapped by her father. Ichika attempts repeatedly to prove that she's a real robot, with hilariously disastrous results.

title: Sakisome Complex
description: Kohinata Riko's love interests are very low. However, she doesn't want to admit it, and knows there's no way she'll be able to admit it, so she keeps it to herself for a long time. One day, while she was having a study session at her classmate Tomoka's house, a girl with a school bag appeared in front of them! It turns out that Tomoka has a younger sister who is still in elementary school. Riko feels like time has stopped because she's so cute, but it seems like the sister has some hostility towards Riko...? A high school girl who has pedophilic urges for children and a girl who wants to become an adult...

title: Sensei ni wa Mada Iwanai
description:
Iijima Otoha has a one-sided crush on her female PE teacher. Everyday after school she heads straight to the PE teacher’s office where she was promised they could spend time together. Starting at 4 o’clock, for one hour, she’s able to be all alone with her. The more time Otoha spends with her teacher the more her feelings for her grow. But, she won’t yet tell her about those feelings. This uncertain yet pure love story between two girls is now available in book form!  
  
![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png)Author's Twitter: <https://twitter.com/m_tenco29Q>

title: Minori & 100 Ladies
description:
Sakura Minori is just a very average girl.  
Yet despite being the only commoner in her school, could it be that she's actually become popular among the young ladies she so admired…!?  
A girls-only lovey-dovey comedy♪

title: Ami-chan no Nikki
description:
"On June X, we switched over to the short-sleeve uniforms."

Ami is the most beautiful girl at Tsubaki High school, who attracts looks from both boys and girls, but she has a secret that she can't tell anyone. That's all written in this diary ...

title: Fragtime
description: What would you do if you could stop time? Moritani for one is using her unusual ability to stop time for three minutes a day to observe the people around her. One day, she chooses to “observe” class idol Murakami’s panties – only to find herself in a very compromising situation when her classmate turns out to be immune to her power.

title: 45 Seconds
description:
Siyeon, who returns home after studying abroad for college, finds out about the 'Understanding Wine' course that her younger sister has picked for her.  
It's very popular because it's about tasting wine, but Sihyeon is a lightweight that can't drink alcohol!  
When she decides to correct the course and attended it, she is reunited with her high school friend Eunha… !?

title: Last Summer Vacation
description: "I ended up seeing that girl in my class who didn't want to be seen by anyone"—The bright and cute Mizuki who selflessly takes care of her sick mother—Seemingly the perfect “good girl” in every respect. But what about Umino, who saw a girl like that in a way she absolutely should not have? What is arriving at the end of escaping from reality? This is sure to be a road trip story about sad girls

title: Dear My Teacher
description: Fujimura Kaoru is the nurse at an all girl's school and, for the third time this year, she has been confessed to by a student. Naturally, she has turned down each offer in the kindest way she could. Isechi Mikoto is a student who has been ostracized by the school because of a rumor that she might be a lesbian. She also happens to remind Kaoru-sensei of her former lover.

title: Shiroki Otome no Jinrou (Werewolf)
description: Hakurai Private Academy, a boarding school where young ladies receive a higher education in bridehood. Should the maidens lose their "purity" during the three year course, they are immediately expelled, losing any chance at their dreams of becoming brides. For the girls living at this school, it is a future they consider worse than death. One day, something happens in the dormitory of the student council! In their midst is a two-faced wolf aiming for their purity - and it is up to them to pull back the mask!

title: Hikizan Tautology
description: A story about girls who want to be similar to someone else.  For her own reasons, almost-third year Minamo Hiratsuka doesn't talk with girls. But then, at night in a train station, she saw the most popular girl at school, Yurika Ayase, kiss a woman.

title: The Main Duties of the Vice President
description: In the student council room, you'll never find more than two people: the president, Haiya Gin (that's me), and the vice president, Kurishita Namida. We used to have a bunch of other officers too, but since the vice president took care of everything so easily, everyone stopped coming. She's incredibly beautiful, and an honor student with no flaws to speak of, but... For some reason, she's always messing with me, and only me?! A comedy featuring the antics of a strangely doting, tall vice president and an adorably tiny president begins!!!

title: Watashi no Tame ni Nuginasai!
description: A shy girl, Ninose Shizuku, is a high schooler who ekes out a living drawing adult-oriented manga. Every day, in order to survive, she pours her heart out working on it, but she encounters a certain problem...

title: Kurasu no Jimiko ni Chokkaidashitara Yarikaesareta
Oshi ga Imouto Ni Narimashite
description:
Ichika Kojima is a high schooler obsessed with the idol "Kanon", beautiful and popular with her (girl) underclassmen, Ichika really only spends her time as an idol fan; her life changes when one day her father remarries and she gets a step-sister, none other than her beloved "little sister of humanity" Kanon, or rather, Akane?! 

This Hyper Yuri Love Comedy begins now☆!

title: Teacher x Student Yuri Anthology Comic
description:
Teacher x Student Yuri  
Cover: Tooyama Ema  
Illustration: Nekota  
  
1. Tooyama Ema  
2. Yoshino Kaya  
3. Kobato Neneko  
4. Noda Nonda  
5. Chioka Nanae  
6. Gotou Yuuki  
7. Nanasaka Nana  
8. Hiratsuka Shino  
9. Sawamura Mariko  
10. Yukio Yuki

title: Lilium Terrarium
description: Girls are troubled by many different things. Things involving love, friends, the latest trends, etc. And this is a youthful yuri omniverse story brought to you by these very girls.

title: Eguchi-san Chi no Junjou Succubus
description: Eguchi Hibiki là một họa sĩ truyện tranh có kiến ​​thức nhưng không hiểu gì về sếch. Trong khi tự hỏi sếch chính xác là gì, Hibiki gặp Yasaki Mia, một succubus cũng đang thắc mắc về "dam dang". Cả hai cùng có điểm chung và quyết định hợp tác để hiểu thêm về "sếch".

title: Nomura Nao to Kyougoku Hina wa
description:
Description via YuriNavi:  
  
"Nomura Nao and Kyougoku Hina" is the story about two high school girls, Nomura Nao and Kyougoku Hina, who sit in the same class. Nao has always had trouble with Hina, who seems to always be in a bad mood. But one day after school, she runs into Hina who is taking care of her younger siblings. Nao dislikes her own family, but seeing Hina as a caring older sister, Nao's opinion of Hina changes drastically. As Nao spends time with the Kyougokus, she starts to learn what family is really about.  
  
The author and artist is Chariot-san (@imgayhowbouthat), who writes creative yuri manga. This work received an honorable mention in the 103rd Newcomer Award of Kodansha's Magazine, and was published on Magapoke in December 2019. It was then uploaded to Chariot's twitter page, and has since received over 60,000 RTs and a great deal of attention.

title: Twins in Agony
description:
Ako and Komachi are twin high schoolers who are famous for being close. They look almost exactly the same, except for the length of their hair. They're also similar in terms of academic performance, but in their latest exams, Ako claimed to be in a "slump" that caused her scores to fall.  
  
Because of this, she has to take remedial English lessons from the assistant homeroom teacher, Oosawa Maki. When asked about the reason for her declining performance, Ako tells her that she was worried about love.

(Chapter 10 (the last chapter) has been TL'd in EN, but you have to search for it, since Aoi Shoujo refuses to post their stuff on MDex)

title: Love Ban School
description:
***If you fall in love, you'll be expelled immediately!***

Aisaki Private Academy. This prestigious and established elite school is characterized by its “Spartan education”. The school's strict regulations prohibit anything that gets in the way of academics. Among these, there's one ironclad rule that especially constricts students: no romance.

The Student Council President, Uemura Erika, who enforces the rules and leads the school, is a figure of beauty, intelligence, and admiration among the students. But when a new student, Machishima Haruto, accidentally discovers her “secret”, he finds himself caught up in the school's various problems.

Extreme love school days set at an elite school!
___
**Alt Official Raw:** [niconico Manga](http://seiga.nicovideo.jp/comic/35118)

title: Okawari Itadaketa darou ka?
description: Suzu Yotsuya is a high school girl who loves to eat. While eating by herself in the cafeteria like usual, she is invited to eat with Majima-san, a tall and popular classmate. However, there are some suspicious rumors going around about Majima-san…⁉

title: KiraKira★Study ~Zettai Goukaku Sengen~
description: Misaki Marei is a second year in high school, and she sucks at studying. She has no real goals in life, and has zero interest in taking the college entrance exam…until her childhood best friend, Micchan, says she's going to college. Now Marei has found her goal: pass the entrance exam for Akamon University, an elite college, and go to school with Micchan.

title: Takane no Hana wa Usotsuki desu
description: Meguru is a high school gal (gyaru) with a reputation for having a long love history… But in reality she is a pure girl with horrible luck in love. One day, Meguru saves a woman from a pervert. That woman turns out to be a beautiful and humble office worker named Yukiho… But, despite her seemingly holy personality, Yukiho has a hidden side…

title: Infinity
description: A manga about a girl who can see the level of affection each person holds for her, and her friend whose affection for her says "∞".

title: Luminous=Blue
description: Kou Tarumizu transfers to the high school of her idol and two time photography contest winner, Uchiho Hayama, only to find that the photography club has been disbanded and Uchiho is in a photographic slump. To revive the club and get Uchiho out of her slump, Kou decides to enter a photography contest and chooses her classmates Nene and Amane as her subjects. But it turns out that the two of them used to be a couple…

title: Seto-san o Warawasetai Tsumugi-chan
description:
Seto-san is a beautiful and cool class president. Her smiling face must be absolutely wonderful. I want to see it! 

This is a short comic in which Tsumugi-chan, a ditzy girl with whom Seto-san has had a little bit of contact with since the entrance ceremony, boldly tries various strategies to make Seto-san laugh — but usually fails. However, there seems to be something quite interesting about Seto-san...

title: Kanojo no Kanojo to Fujun na Hatsukoi
description:
"In exchange for my help with your studies, you must stay let me stay at your house until summer vacation."

If I get a failing mark again, my chance to live by myself will be over. So I'm forced to go along with the proposal from Tsukasa, the smartest and most beautiful girl in school. But then I saw them. I saw Tsukasa kissing a girl in the park. Tsukasa, who often annoys me with her abnormal invasions of my personal space, has a “girlfriend." Her yuri friend is against this arrangement because she thinks it's “cheating” even if it's between two girls, but Tsukasa is having none of it. After a while, my grades are improving and I'm beginning to enjoy living with Tsukasa. I know that “it's not cheating if you're not in love with them,” but…

I'm okay with it. If I don't think about love, we can all get along and be happy, right?

title: LaLa
description:
Xia Yuxin's presence at school never fails to draw attention. She has a mature beauty about her, always poised, and exuding confidence in class. Being admired so much by her classmates, one would think she's a well-respected senior but in truth, it might be because she's a repeat student. Xia Yuxin has more to her elegant facade.


---

**Links:**
- [Alternative official English](https://www.webcomicsapp.com/comic/Lala/5c0a4df8d5626e75ff1f2d11)

title: The Class Rep With Weak Ears and The Punk Gyaru-chan Who Attacks Ears
description: The straight-laced class rep tries to get the gyaru Kazuki to follow the school rules. Becomes an ASMR addict instead. Y'know, the usual.

title: Kono Kakegae no Nai Jigoku
description:
An anthology with five oneshots.
To explain the title: each story contains  "replacement", in other word "change" - change of genre of manga, change of decision etc, and one hell of consequences that the said change brings with it.

title: Kokono-Chan Drinks Tears!
description: A pair of classmates have a unique relationship.

title: Hide Your Tears, You Crybaby
description:
The serialization of [Today I'll (Make You) Confess](<https://mangadex.org/title/57775/today-i-ll-make-you-confess>)  
  
[Author's Weibo](<https://weibo.com/u/5548091947?refer_flag=1005055013_>)

title: Love Death
description:
"In this entire world, there is no greater eyesore."  
  
Shouko and Akki are high school friends who take yandere to the next level: they can only express their feelings through highly stylistic violence.  
  
A complementary story to "Nicochuu", by the same author.

title: Hertz Around You
description: Electromagnetic waves craft an illusionary world. Electromagnetic wave user Wei Xiaoran slips in and out of this world— saving others, as well as herself!

title: Kawasemi-san no Tsurigohan
description:
A high school student, Kawasemi, who has transferred to the countryside, spends her days alone due to her shyness. One day, she is approached by her classmate Misago, a so-called 'countryside Yankee', and was taken to the mountains. Kawasemi was afraid of what she would do, but then MIsago starts fishing!? 

An outdoor life manga where a cooking lover JK meets a fishing lover JK!

title: Sexy in Pink
description: Hanami Harumaki is a high school P.E. teacher with daily morning entrance duty at the school's gate. Tomboyish and awkward, she meets a new student, Urara Momojima, who surprisingly, has natural and striking pink hair (pink haired girls have a reputation for lewdness in dating sim games). Momojima immediately takes a liking to Ms. Harumaki, and makes her best to seduce her, but they're both not particularly "smart" girls. Watch them as they stupidly stumble their way to love!!!

title: Neko ni Hakucho, Hotaru ni Koban
description: Art teacher Hase Hotaru is confounded by one of her students, Nekome Yuna. Yuna fell in love at first sight with Shiratori Ako, a contract teacher at the same school, and she cannot do anything but pursue her. However, Ako has a quirk, the depths of which are yet unknown. A student hopelessly in love and the adults around her being yanked around.

title: Honto no Kokoro
description:
Oono-san is a loner student, but has a secret – somehow, she has come to be able to read minds. This would be annoying but not a problem, except for her art teacher, Nakamura – who is head over heels in love with her.   
  
… And is a horny pervert. A really really horny, perverted lesbian who constantly thinks about her.

title: Sakura Nadeshiko
description: Two girls who want to become idols are entering into their long dreamed school—Kiraboshi-juku—Kiraboshi Nadeshiko and her close friend Mangetsu Sakurako. These two are so close that despite both being girls, they're often compared to a married couple by people around them.

title: I'm More Dangerous Than You
description:
When Jiang Wanshu met Ren Pingsheng, what she thought was her light, became the beginning of her nightmare. As a teacher, Ren Pingsheng seems gentle and considerate on the outside, but is secretly an extremely passionate reader of Jiang Wanshu's book. What seemed to be a "coincidental" first encounter was in truth calculated and planned.   
  
Behind the peaceful days, the crazy reader has begun her hunt…  
  


---

title: Yuri ni Hasamaru Otoko wa Shineba Ii!?
description: This is a manga about a female brass band member who was proud of playing 1st, when a transfer student who played 1st at a strong school at the national level appears. This manga depicts the unnameable emotions of the members of the girls' brass band.

title: Koisuru Asteroid
description:
Astronomy and geology are fun…!

Mira, who promised to “find an asteroid” with the boy she found at the campsite as a child. She tried to join the astronomy club, but from this year the “astronomy club” and the “geology research society” merged into the “earth sciences club”!? Let’s go search for the asteroid that we promised to look for that day.

title: Sweet Blue Flowers
description:
Fumi and Akira were best friends when they were little, with Akira always looking after the crybaby Fumi, but that all ended when Fumi's family moved away. Several years later, Fumi's family returned, and she and Akira happened to bump into each other on their way to school. They became friends again, quickly slipping back into old patterns. Shortly after, Fumi began dating a cool, attractive upperclassman who, coincidentally enough, had ties to Akira's current school, the prestigious Fujigaya Girls' Academy.

title: Opapagoto
description: The importance of "family" is being forgotten. At an all-girls school, a program to simulate and nurture family ties is carried out. Each student plays the role of father, mother, or child at random. Ayagasaki Kasuga is a girl who has been assigned the role of father in this outrageous project.

title: Kinsei No Reveal
description:
Kugami Sugara just wants to lead a peaceful school life.  
But being chosen by the beautiful and talented Shirasagi Yui to be her pseudo 'sister', her life is anything but peaceful.  
And to make things even more interesting, Yui's cold but capable identical twin sister (and also student council president), Shirasagi Ui, also takes an interest in Sugara.  
  
From there, things go as well as you might expect in this yuri comedy!

title: My Idol Sits the Next Desk Over!
description: Manaka Sakiko is a huge fan of Chihiro, an idol from the idol group Haruiro Sunshine, and on her first day of high school she finds out the new girl sitting next to her is none other than Chihiro herself. No one else recognises Chihiro, so Sakiko resolves to keep her knowledge under wraps, but when she accidentally slips and reveals she's a fan, she unwittingly makes herself the enemy of another Chihiro devotee, one who isn't keen on sharing.

title: Tsukiatte Agete mo Ii kana
description: College students Saeko and Miwa end up drunkenly coming out to each other on a night out, and the two of them enter into a relationship to celebrate the concept of finally actually getting to have a girlfriend… so, what could possibly go wrong?

title: Mirai no Fuufu Desu Kedo?
description: The story of a future married couple.

title: Fluttering Feelings
description:
The story of two people brought together by the fluttering feelings that they know nothing about.

Note: Discontinued due to the author passing away.

"I haven't been able to convey the tantalizing feeling that you gave me, this time I'll definitely ―" Nagi, a high school girl who likes beautiful voices, and Michiru, her classmate with the ideal clear and beautiful voice. When nobody was watching, their story started with letters exchanged during class. 

The author's long-awaited first short stories collection dedicated to nine pairs of girls, including the title "Resonant Blue" - a lively and youthful relationship between two clumsy and straight-forward high school girls.

description: After being hospitalized, Sana, meets a mysterious girl at the vending machine named Kousaka Ayane. They are both interested in each other and start spending time in their rooms. With every meeting Sana experiences new emotions which she hasn't felt before. After Ayane's doctor tells her that she is going to leave hospital she meets Sana one more time…

title: Transfer Student
description:
Their friendship seems stronger than anything. But will it resist the appearance of a beautiful student? For Nare and Minsu, nothing is less certain. No need to lie, one thing is obvious for the two friends: Nare is completely captivated by her new classmate. So when the pretty stranger tries to become friends with Nare, the latter does nothing to stop her…

title: Only Show Yourself to Me
description:
After moving to big city, small town high school girl Tano-San finds the culture shock immense and only wishes to go back to the country side.

That is until she meets the beautiful yet mysterious Rurika Towa, a girl who is super popular with boys and yet has no female friends.

Will an unlikely friendship begin between the two girls or will it turn into something more?

title: Joou-sama no Eshi
description: Fujimaki barely scrapes by in school grade-wise. But he thinks all is well, because he just has to quit school and become a top-selling mangaka. It is that easy! One day he catches his hyper-intelligent classmate Yukimori masturbating to eromanga in an abandoned room in school. One thing leads to another and he gets blackmailed into drawing eromanga for her.

title: Today I'll (Make You) Confess
description:
The life of 2 "normal" high school girls? Su Mu wants to overcome her anxiety to confess to Lin Dai Xue, on the other side Dai Xue keeps making opportunities for Su Mu to confess. Both of them know each other well but neither of them is willing to be truthful to the other.  
  
[Author's Weibo](https://weibo.com/u/5548091947?refer_flag=1005055013_)

title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy
description:
"This isn't the life that I wanted."  
  
On the day of her wedding, Eunha, who has hidden the fact that she's a lesbian her entire life, decides to jump off a building and end her life, not wanting to devote her life to a person she can't love. Just as she leaps, she closes her eyes and wistfully reminiscences her first love whom she never told her feelings for… only to find herself 10 years back in high school when she opens her eyes. As she is reunited with her first love, will Eunha be able to turn back her ill-fated life? (From From Zero Scanlations)

title: Oogami-san and Cerberus!
description: When Oogami-san is confessed to by one of three dog-eared girls, Keru, Bero and Suu, they become friends and start hanging out with each other. Will this friendship eventually turn into love!? A love story between three identical triplets with completely different personalities and a beautiful lone wolf.

title: Oyasumi, Scheherazade
description:
Rumor has it that there is a witch inside room 13 of the girls' dormitory, who lures innocent, unsuspecting girls into her room at night to perform indecent acts on them….   
In truth, the girl in room 13, Herazato Shie, is just unable to fall asleep at night unless she tells someone a story about the movies she has watched. So every night, she invites anyone willing to come in her room and listen to another of her stories about movies.

title: Yuri Hyakkei
description: A full-color manga featuring 100 scenes of girls love! Featuring classmates, senpai and kouhai, teacher and student, sisters and childhood friends!

title: Kimi ni Naretara
description:
If only she could be like her...

Ordinary high schooler Takasaki Chieri's reason for living was stanning the idol Amano Ichika who was exploding in popularity. But then...

title: Finder Goshi no Ano Ko
description:
Hajime, a girl who can’t seem to properly express her feelings into words, is worrying all on her own about the preparations for the cultural festival. This will be the last festival for her film club. There’s always been things she’s wanted to do for the festival, but like last year, she’s given up and the festival will probably end without her doing what she wants to do.  
That’s when she meets Kei Ichinose, another student at her schoolー

title: Honto no Kanojo
description: Moe confesses to Yuuka who rejects her harshly in a haughty manner different from her usual "good girl" personality… but Moe seemed to enjoy it?

title: Akuma no Riddle
description:
At a boarding girls' high school where every student is assassin, they target only one life - "Ichinose Haru". Similarly, "Azuma Tokaku" is an assassin who transferred schools to target her, however she gradually became attracted to "Haru" and decided to protect her. Extreme school life START!  
  
See [AnimeNewsNetwork](https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=15767) for the anime.

title: Yuri to Koe to Kaze Matoi
description:
A high school girl who has never known love meets an older woman with a secret...
A junior in high school, Matoi Noshita has never liked anyone and is fed up with being involved in her younger sister's and friends' boyfriend situations.
One day, she meets Yuriko, who has just moved from Tokyo. At a local driving school, she asks her to drive her home on her motorcycle.
Matoi is perplexed by her own curiosity about a woman whose name she does not know and where she lives.
"What on earth is this feeling I am having for the first time...?"

title: Hametsu no Koibito
description: Is that woman a ghost or a witch? A chance encounter between a girl and a beautiful, but not ghostly, girl who lives in a haunted house like a secret base.

But what happens to the evil queen after? Exiled to the isolated, bleak Northern island, she awaits her execution; thirty days of waiting, with only a nonchalant guard as company. If she is to live, she must find a way out. Will she be able to escape in time, defying all odds? Or will she succumb to fate?

title: Hana to Hoshi
description: Hanai is a junior higher and the best at table tennis. She's never lost, and she's won many tournaments, but after some freshman she's never heard of beats her like it was nothing, she starts losing every game after that and she can't get rid of that feeling of defeat. Now it's her first day of high school and she's decided to quit table tennis and live an ordinary high school life, but on the first day, she runs into the very girl that first defeated her. It turns out that she's also quit table tennis, but this girl always has a cold expression on her face and Hanai can't help but feel that this girl is always looking down on her and trying to mess up her perfect high school life. One day the girl falls asleep in class, and Hanai reaches over to wake her up. As she does so, the girl, still half asleep, looks up at her with a smile and almost kisses her. The girl later tells Hanai that she was having a dream about her, but Hanai coldly brushes it off thinking she's just messing with he

title: Uso to Kiss wa Houkago ni
description:
Thanks to a bad mother obsessed with men, Rin lost a warm house when she was young. The one who supported her at that time was the family of her childhood friend, Momoka.

...but, at some point Momoka began dating men, one after another, as she indulged in the feeling of love. Almost exactly like the mother that had left Rin behind.
"I won't be satisfied if I'm not loved" Momoka boasts. After she's admonished by Rin, she suggests "Then, you do it Rin. Love me, in place of a boyfriend".
And thus, from kisses and lies, begins a girls' love story.

title: Boita Boine
description: Haine is a boyish tomboy highschool girl who wants her very own yuri harem. She gets confident after helping a girl on the first day of school, but standing in the way of her goal is Shizuka, another boyish highschool girl who's seen as a prince and steals girls' hearts without even trying! Haine's new goal is to defeat Shizuka and build her yuri harem! A yuri comedy full of ruthlessness and bickering between two rival tomboys!

title: Shiawase Tori-mingu
description:
Suzu, an art student in a creative rut, finds new inspiration when she meets a beautiful girl at the park who introduces her to the colourful world of birdwatching.  
  
Serialised monthly in Manga Time Kirara.

title: Dareka Ookami-san no Shitsukekata Shirimasen ka!?
description:
Ookami-san has arrived at school.

Himura Akane, a sophomore and member of the discipline committee, is very studious, but also sincere, petite, and adorable, making her beloved by everyone at school and very popular. One day, the principal asks her to be the tutor in charge of the education of Ookami Ren, the daughter of the board chairman. Since Akane's goal is to enter college on a scholarship, she decides to accept the assignment. However, Ren turns out to be much bigger than her physically and, on top of that, a troublesome girl with a cunning mind full of bad ideas...!?

title: Minasoko nite
description: Người ta nói rằng dưới đáy hồ ở thị trấn này có một "người cá" chuyên ăn thịt người. Ngay cả bây giờ cũng vậy, người cá lang thang trong thị trấn để tìm kiếm bạn đồng hành, chạm đến những trái tim đang gợn. Đây là truyện ngụ ngôn hiện đại về những cô gái khờ khạo không thể sống nhờ nước sạch.

title: Blooming Sequence
description: Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing “Dancing in the Rain” while… dancing in the rain. It’s a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who’s not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat.

title: Ichigo no Haitta Soda-sui
description:
Mannenrou Ladies' Academy is famous for its upper class and posh students.
Despite knowing how out-of-place she'd be, the former yankee, Hanaizumi Luna, decides to enroll there.
Moreover, according to her underling: "Girls' schools means yuri!! Add in school dormitories? Now that's a world of girl on girl action!!"

title: Nengan no Akuyaku Reijo (Last Boss) no Karada wo Te ni Ireta zo!
description:
A sickly girl named Elizabeth has been reincarnated as an otome game villainess! She begins her life anew, blissfully unaware that her fate is to be killed by the heroes. She might enjoy a healthy life now, but will she be able to turn fate on its head!?
___
[Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n6944hx/)

title: Black Lily to Shirayuri-chan
description: A high class all girls school that grooms their students to become a proper lady with manners… or so it should’ve been. But somehow the public morals is a bit loose… the proud honour student, lily is giving the students [freedom] in the school?!

title: Komori-san and Yoshizawa-san
description: Small collection of various yuri shorts drawn by [Rococo](twitter.com/rococomm123/)

title: Rutou-san ni wa Kanaimasen!
description:
Being the top student in the class, Rutou Kaname is always in the public eye; on the contrary, quiet and trivial, Wamura Chihiro usually spends time talking with her otaku friends in the corner of the classroom. 
Being front-and-back deskmates, Kaname and Chihiro should have no common language. However, as Kaname strikes up a conversation, a special friendship starts.

title: Uso kara Hajimaru Koi no Natsu -squall-
description:
Kaoru, who had run away from home, is found and protected by her main teacher, Mirei, in the rain. At school, the teacher seemed like a responsible adult, but at home, her attitude is careless, drinking alcohol during the day and making jokes with a smile on her face. However, she accepts and understands the worries that Kaoru could not cope with.... Thus begins the faltering romance of two people who cannot yet become adults.

An official manga adapting the visual novel "Uso kara Hajimaru Koi no Natsu" that was not shown in the main story, focusing on the relationship between a teacher and her student, portraying a love story, Youth ✕ Summer ✕ Yuri.

A story about a 175cm tall girl and her crush, a 160cm tall girl.

You can find the chapters on the author's [twitter](https://x.com/taaro222/status/1618177688665194497).

title: Hand Of The Abyss
description:
[Top Student Meets Popular Queen Bee] What secrets are these quiet girls hiding?
Zheng Shan found the lost class fee money in her locker. This was seen by Mary and several other classmates. In a panic, Zheng Shan hid the money. This caused a misunderstanding that she was the one who stole the class fee money. However, the class monitor, Mary, did not accuse Zheng Shan of theft. Instead, she reached out to her. Will it be a helping hand or a hand to pull Zheng Shan into the abyss?

Kurata Hikaru has fallen in love with her classmate Kira Kairi at first sight. Now, she's too lovestruck to concentrate on her studies. Her plan? Get Kairi to reject her so she can focus again.

Yuri Hime oneshot published in March 2024.

title: Yurizukushi no Kyoushitsu de
description:
"Everyone is the main character in the story of their own life."

The stories of a 2nd year 1st class attended by 30 unique students, at a certain girls' high school with a decent standard.
Every day the class is so busy and lively that you won't get bored.

If you look closely at the classroom, you can see the thoughts of each of the 30 students.
A school omnibus that watches over unique and a "yuriful'' classroom!

In a Yuriful Classroom

title: Robot Izonkei Joshi no Meiwaku na Nichijou

The near future lily comedy that beautiful girls flirt! Genius robot pilot high school girl, Hagane. I'm withdrawing and staying in the cockpit. I don’t want to go to the bathroom, so I wear diapers. I love Kotoha-chan, my only friend. “You can't do anything other than maneuvering the robot, but to return a huge debt, you will find a handy man from searching for lost dogs to getting rid of ghosts…!

First official comic anthology for the much-discussed Adachi to Shimamura!  
  
Iruma Hitoma's popular novel series Adachi to Shimamura now in comic anthology form!

title: Philia to Eros no Aida
description: Hoshigawa Kurumi has a crush on her classmate, Nikaidou Nika, who sits in front of her in class. She's popular with guys so she has no trouble going from boyfriend to boyfriend. One day, Nikaidou borrows an eraser from Hoshigawa.

title: Midareta Futari no Mitasare Gohan
description:
The office lady who decided she wouldn't eat too much no matter how hungry she is, Hikami Runa. The high school girl who eats whenever she feels like it regardless of the time or place, Koizumi Ichika. Runa's restraint means she won't make any compromises when it comes to eating delicious things. Ichika isn't fussy when it comes to eating and doesn't know anything about ways to make things tastier.
When these two eat together, it becomes an "obsecene meal"!

title: From Today I'll Be a Goddess
description: A normal, honest sophomore guy, whose life was changed when he became a super beautiful girl. Who was the one that caused it? Are there any more misfortunes lying in wait for him/her? What kind of charming experiences will he have…?

title: Futsuu no Koitte Nani?
description:
**Is my "red string of fate" connected to you?**

The high school first year "me" that fell in love at first sight at the school entrance ceremony. But that love was not normal...
A yuri story depicted from the point of view of three high school girls.

title: Sasayaku You ni Koi wo Utau: Koushiki Comic Anthology
description: The first official "Sasayaku You ni Koi o Utau'" comic anthology is here! Talented authors with unique styles tell stories that begin with a crush at first sight. [Participating Authors] COVER: Aono Nachi. ILLUSTRATIONS: Yosuke Kaneda, Miman. COMICS: Aotsubaki Toto, Aono Shimo, Ito Hachi, Inui, Utatane Yuu, Sikusiku, Torii Shizuku, Nekotarou, Haruhana Aya, Mukunoki Nanatsu, Yuama, Yukiko.

However, it turned out to be a girl from her school, Kurumizawa Haruka, and moreover, she had to help her. After the event, they decided to go out for a meal, at Haruka's suggestion... Meet the students: Aoi Fujisawa, the always-hungry council president, Kanade Kawagoe, the thick-browed silent beauty vice president, Minami Otsuka, the do-what-I-want sadist, and Hana Koganei, the petite short haired second year. That Public Morals Committee Member is being a pain. Let's make fun of her.

(**Each chapter is different and does not follow one another**.)

title: Kodomo-beya Dragon
description:
**One day, I suddenly found myself with a shut-in dragon stepsister**

Gyao, a spoiled dragon who's been pampered by her papa her whole life, and Himari, brimming with curiosity about the ways of other worlds.

Along with their quirky friends, they bring you a slightly naughty, over-the-top yuri gag 4-koma!
Pushing yuri to its very limits—Kirara-style!

(Source: NicoNico Manga, edited)

title: Riko to Haru to Onsen to Iruka
description: Due to circumstances regarding her mother’s work, Riko was left alone in Japan to live in the countryside. In the place providing her lodging, her energetic and mysterious childhood friend Haru awaits!!

title: Furumapura
description: Energetic girl Kyou meets quiet girl Makoto, who only communicates using sign boards numbered 1 to 10. At first, these polar opposites interact rather one-sidedly, but gradually become able to understand each other's feelings.

title: My Elder Sister's Friend
description: At the age of 14, her first lover was her sister's former best friend, Kyouko. It was a time where Noriko would meet Kyouko after school and be thrilled by the smell of her adult perfume and enchanting eyes, nothing like spending time with her boring classmates. But why did Kyouko and her sister stop being friends in the first place? This is the story of three women and their discovery of what true “love” entails.

title: Our Similarities
description: You must take the fall with me.The abuse people suffer during their childhood will all burst out all at once when they grow up. Some people choose to vent their anger to the outside world, but some people will only keep it in and torture themselves.

title: ผู้ชนะรักนี้ต้องเป็นฉัน
description: Although Captain is handsome, kind, and good at sports, he’s also an avid gamer. That’s the reason why Kiss decided to start learning how to play games in hopes of winning over the senior she has a crush on. However, this turned out to be the beginning of an unexpected online relationship between Kiss and Miguel, who is secretly the world's number one pro player!

title: Men Men Musubi
description:
1. Men Men Musubi
2. Osorosoroi
3. Fuusen Kazura wa Kyou mo Tobanai
4. Kuiki-gai Kandan-ryou
5. Flying Cosmos
6. Hatsu Arashi no Tsumugi Uta
7. Kuramujii Call

title: Outsider Paradise
description:
From the author of Asobi Asobase comes a new comedy series, about… the Art Club from Asobi Asobase.

Oficial chapter 1 RAW: https://comic-action.com/episode/14079602755364921618

Due to health problems, the author said that the work would be on hiatus (from December 2024).

title: Kyou wa Mada Futsuu ni Narenai
description: Takahashi, a 27-year-old freelancer who likes cute girls, and Yamashita, a fast-paced but sensitive manga artist. At the end of their high school years, the two, who had no desire to find a job or go on to higher education, have been together ever since they got detention for their desired career path. Going on to higher education, getting a job, getting married...they are troubled by the "futsuu" they often encounter in their lives, but somehow manage to stay positive. Two girls. A just-right relationship that loosely fits their hearts.

title: 10-nenmae ni Osananajimi to Kekkon Suru Yakusoku Shita kedo
description: 10年前に幼馴染と結婚する約束したけど、実は女同士で…!?

title: Prism
description: Riding high on the memory of a boy named Hikaru with whom she spent a day during her last year of grade school, Megu went through middle school without romance. Now that she's a high school student, she has decided she is finally completely over her first love and can look towards the future. But! Megu meets a pretty girl on her first day of high school who gives her a big hug, and her name is Hikaru?!

title: Pink Ribbon
description:
Lumiao is a senior high school student who loves to dress up in frilly dresses and bows. One day she passes another student, the petite Yuxuan, on campus, and becomes convinced she has the perfect frame for the same style. But Yuxuan, a shy and short-haired sports-lover, resists her new friend’s attempts to both persuade and trick her into a new look.

But as time goes on, Lumiao realizes her feelings for Yuxuan go beyond friendship and she becomes obsessed with everything Yuxuan does and thinks. What is Lumiao to do when she learns Yuxuan has a crush on a boy in her class? She wants Yuxuan to be happy, but she doesn’t want to lose her. What will happen if she tells Yuxuan how she feels?

___

[Artist website](https://lufbsis.wixsite.com/mondayrecover)
[Artist instagram](https://www.instagram.com/monday_recover)
[Artist pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/2179028)

[Purchase the raws, support the author](https://www.bookwalker.com.tw/product/85166)

title: Sono Koi Yokini Hakarae!
description: A classroom suddenly becomes a battlefield of love! Love that transcends time and space! A Japanese-history teacher is confessed to for the first time in their life, but there's a problem! It's a highschool girl!? Using the advice of a general from 1000 years ago, can they navigate the warzone?

title: Majime Girl to Seishun Lingerie
description: If you are pretty into lingerie, and that’s what this series is all about. Our main characters are named Ran and Geraldine, or put another way, “Ran” and “Gerry” or uh, lingerie.

title: Bié Mō Wǒ ěr Duǒ
description: Ruan Ning is a sophomore at Hongcheng High School. She is the class president, the number one student in her grade, and the most popular girl at school. But she has a secret, she's a beast-person, and nobody can see her ears or tail, at least until a beautiful new transfer student comes along.

title: Ginsei no Proust
description: Kazuki, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and a straight-A student at a prestigious school for girls, meets Moeka, a wild girl from a rowdy school. What becomes of Kazuki when witnessing a steamy moment between Moeka and her boyfriend leaves her all shaken up...?! Find out in this seaside tale of two polar opposites and their fated encounter.

title: Shirotae-Sama, Himitsu desuyo
description: Utao Hananoi is a student at a prestigious academy—that’s meant for vampires! As a human, she must keep her identity a secret as humans are still considered food for the supernatural beings. But despite her best attempts, her secret is discovered by Shirotae… the progenitor of vampires! Thankfully, Shirotae offers to keep Utao’s secret, for now. Will Utao be able to keep her secret and her life or does Shirotae have other ideas in mind? (Seven Seas)

title: Zankou Saisatsu
description: Kurume Amane, a member of her university’s photography club, believes that “girls in love are the cutest,” and is a total slut who makes her female subjects fall for her before sleeping with them and taking their photos. Amane had been struggling to take any decent photos, but one day, a beautiful girl named Mei showed up at the clubroom with a broken camera—

title: Qyootie Q -Qilin Girl's Courtship-
description:
Kuchiba, a good looking girl feared for her fiery personality, decides that she's not going to get into any more fights now that she's a high school student.

However, on her very first day of school, she gets caught up in a scrap with a girl named Qisha, one of the "werefolk", who considers her an enemy because of a misunderstanding. Werefolk are a rare type of demihuman, with only 30,000 living in Japan, and Qisha has heard that Kuchiba has been busy bullying them.

Because of that, she challenges Kuchiba to a duel, but...

title: Kuchi ni Dashitemo Yoroshii Desuka?
description:
Ooshiratorizawakane Himeyuriko is a super duper rich young lady.
As a result of following her family precept of ``live honestly'' too thoroughly, she becomes a girl who openly and frankly tells everything she thinks about, including her romantic feelings and sexual proclivities.
She falls in love at first sight with Tachibana Yui, a high school girl who has an unapproachable aura of a domineering yankee, although she expresses her feelings, all that comes out of her mouth are vulgar words.

Will there ever be a time when this one-sided love will be rewarded, in which she does not give up even when she is ignored or treated with a curt attitude, and keeps her love aura at full blast?!

Himeyuriko's pure love (including her sexuality) runs wild in this love comedy!

title: The Desperate March of Love
description:
"Hey, do you want to go out with me?"

Rei has been in love with Ami, a girl in her class. She confesses her feelings to Ami, expecting to be rejected, but to her surprise, Ami feels the same way! They become lovers, but there is something a little strange about Ami. She thinks about Ami all the time and loves her wholeheartedly, whereas Rei loves her, Ami, on the other hand, has a more liberal view of love and does not choose just one lover. Will Rei love for her win out, or will the unfaithful Ami get away with it?

title: Kashimashi ~Girl Meets Girl~
description:
Being a girl is harder than it looks…  
For Hazumu, this couldn't be more true, because just the other day, she…was a he.  
  
Shunned by the girl of his dreams, Hazumu loses himself in the mountains and is promptly squashed by an oncoming space ship. The alien inside, feeling guilty, rebuilds Hazumu's body…but as the wrong gender!  
  
Now Hazumu must learn how to be the girl his parents always wanted while dealing with the trials and tribulations of being caught in a love triangle between two girls–his childhood friend, Tomari, and Yasuna, the girl who rejected him but is now strangely attracted to him/her!

title: Aruiha, Watashi No Mei Tantei
description:
High schooler Odagiri Momo leaves her home island to attend high school on the mainland. Having grown up on a boring island, Momo dreams of becoming a detective and is always on the lookout for cases. After moving into her first apartment, she meets the mysterious beauty Akaishi Kotone and falls for her at first sight. Declaring she'll make the reluctant Kotone her “assistant” against her will, the two form a buddy team to solve small everyday mysteries together.

(Source: Comic Cune, translated)

title: A Story About How She Grew Conscious of Her Childhood Friend
The Prince of the Girls’ School Seems to Only Have Eyes for Me Yuri Anthology Comic
description:
"At the school I attend, there's a so-called 'prince of the girls' school.' Beautiful and accomplished — she's beloved by all. But for some reason, this prince seems to only have eyes for me...?!"

A yuri anthology comic of short love stories about various princes, including sparkling princes, athletic princes, and secret-otaku princes.

title: Kamitsuki Gakuen
description: The story is Shizuka’s awakening to life as a vampire, while she befriends classmates and fellow Epicureans, and tries to befriend Ichi-gou. Shizuka, on account of never feeding directly from a person is runty, and her bat wings are little, but with help she learns to find the idea of sucking Ichi-gou’s blood alluring.

title: Pages in Search of a Bookmark
description: The story of two girls with a shared love of books falling in love at the library.

title: Kakegurui Midari
description: Spinoff of *Kakegurui* focusing on Midari Ikishima and her past.

title: Hajimari no Joshi Kouishitsu
description: Mio and the Class President are alone in the changing room and find out that they have a thing in common… and then they start finding more *interesting* things in the mean time…

title: Houmurareta Kimi e
description:
In ten or so years, in a future where resurrecting the dead is an everyday occurrence, the moon will collide with the Earth, bringing with it the end.
Before the apocalypse happens, Nekuro confesses to her best friend Kiri, who, seeing no hope for the future, takes her admirer's confession half-joklingly, until one day, Nekuro dies.

title: I Don't Need a Happy Ending
description: A collection of yuri shorts stories by Mikanuji, previously published in various other anthologies

title: Koi Yori Aoku (Oneshot)
description: Takamine, who can't find anything she likes, and Sakikura, who loves books. The two girls meet by chance and spend their after-school hours together. Are they friends? Or is it a nameless relationship spun between the two girls?

title: Black Black Lotus
description:
Câu chuyện về học viện nữ sinh, trang web kết bạn và vụ án giết người...
Bắt đầu mở màn cho câu chuyện tình đầy mới lạ này!

title: I Got a Girlfriend From a Shooting Star
description: What do I do if I like girls? I wished upon a shooting star, not expecting it to be granted straight away… so why did a spirit suddenly appear before me?

title: Kimi to Nara, Ashita o Utaeru no
description:
"That day, when I met you, my world, where I couldn't even speak, was filled with music."

High school student Fujieda Yuzuki is the “kind girl” whom everyone adores. She prioritizes those around her ー her friends and her boyfriend ― all while hiding her true feelings. She's not good at speaking her mind. Putting others first had been Yuzuki's way of life up until then. That is, until she met her.

One day, Yuzuki comes across a girl singing and playing her guitar on the street. Unable to forget her voice, she finds herself humming the melody she heard while alone in her classroom after school. Suddenly, that girl — Terada Hinata — appears. It turns out that Hinata attends the same high school as she does. Then, she stuns Yuzuki by saying, “I came from the future to save you!”

This is a cute and lovely Girl Meets Girl × School Romance story!!

(Source: Young Ace Up, translated)

title: Henai
description: One shot from yuri hime

title: Sayonara ja Nee yo, Baka.
description:
**Contents:**
1. Business Yuri Idol
2. Bishokuka na Kyuuketsuki
3. Nee-chan wa Kuso Yarou
4. Mahou Shounen to Tsukaima Onee-chan
5. Gakuen no Ouji to Hime
6. Kaizuka-san no Inu
7. Otaku no Koto ga Ki ni Naru Gal
8. Isekai Tensei Shita Tomodachi
9. Business Yuri Idol prologue
10. Mangaka no Koto ga Ki ni Naru OL

title: To Whom the Deer Falls
description: Lu Nanzhi reincarnated into a stand-in romance novel as vicious female rival, and her task is to make the heroine Chen Xi achive happiness. The industry beauty thought that attacking the heroine was also a way to ‘make the heroine happy’, so she took the initiative to pursue the heroine. But she gradually felt that the attitude towards herself from the surrounding characters seemed to be different from that in the book?

title: Green Plum Blossom Tea
description: Good girl Gugu meets cheerful girl Xingxing. Xingxing is everything Gugu wants to be - she has friends, youthfulness, dreams, and happiness. The meticulous Gugu sets out a long-term plan to reach out to Xingxing, but it seems that she doesn't have to go to all that trouble... Is Xingxing also reaching out to her?

title: Nanashi no Asterism
description:
Tsukasa Shiratori, Nadeshiko Washio and Mikage Kotooka are three close-knit friends in junior high school. For almost a year, Tsukasa has been harboring a secret she can't tell anyone: she has a crush on Nadeshiko. She resigns to keep it locked away forever, but then discovers that Nadeshiko has a crush on Mikage. Not wanting to mess up their current relationship, Tsukasa decides to support Nadeshiko in any way she can. However, Mikage has a secret of her own that she can't share with anyone.  
  
- [Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/udonkimuchikaki/)

title: Citrus Anthology
description: Citrus official anthology.

title: Daily Life of Kitsune-san
description:
**Read from right to left**
Hana, a cute fox demon, and her friends display their chaotic (un)usual days.

---

- **[Prequal teaser - on youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ovyKnOQsDxA)**

title: Matazoro.
description:
A teen disaster comedy about 3 girls who failed the grade.

After spending nearly a year as a shut-in, Koto enters first year of high school for the second time.
Together with fellow repeating students Shiki (held back due to poor health) and Tomoe (held back due to excessive free-spiritedness), as well as the expectation-immune, habitually late grade retention reserve army cadet Kaede, her experience of school life is rather different from the norm, but delightful in its own way.

title: Himegoto: The Adult Virgin and the Experienced High Schooler
description: A small collection of yuri manga by Shimizu Hikarino.

title: Hummingbird Effect
description:
[Winner of Bomtoon's BL & GL Contest]  
  
A few generations ago, a mysterious phenomenon occurred. Humans now die after 1.5 billion heart beats; half the heart rate they originally had. Schools began teaching students how to control their emotions and regularly preformed heart rate tests.   
No one is allowed to use more than the number assigned per week.  
  
This is the story of 2 girls that chose to love in this world regardless of their heartbeats.

title: After School Adventure
description:
She has a crush on her. So, she makes the first step and leaves her with a cute kiss. Except, they're both clueless about each other's intentions!  
GL with LGBTQ+ side characters as well!  
Ch 14 + 15 are NSFW (read at your own discretion) (also the reason for smut tag). Everything else is sfw.  
[Author's Weibo](https://www.weibo.com/milinainai)

title: -PIQUANT-
description: Just an every day life of cute girls doing cute things.

title: Seikyouiku 120%
description:
"Sex" made more familiar!  
  
Health and physical education teacher Tsuji, who has doubts about modern sex education, attempts boldly to teach sex education to an audience of, among others, a girl who has a girlfriend, a girl who like BL, and a girl who simply likes cats.   
"What is safe sex between girls?" "Positive masturbation?" "Why do sugar gliders (Petaurus breviceps) have vaginas?"  
Beyond dirty jokes, but less than gravely serious, a sex education comedy!   
Bright sex education begins with a heretical female teacher and female high schoolers!  
  
Licensed in English by Yen Press as of 10/11/20

title: Yume Miru Prima Girl!
description: Miyu is an amateur ballerina who wants to become a real star of the stage in the future. Unfortunately, not only the school club is empty but also Miyu's loneliness and lack of skill are barriers between her and her goal. But suddenly, there are people who want to join the club…! Yet, the problem is that both their dancing styles and personalities have nothing to do with the grace of ballet. Are they capable enough to stand and support each other?

title: Reliance
description: Spin-off story of 14-sai no Koi, featuring Aoi Shiki (a lesbian side character in an unrequited love with the FMC of the main story) and a new character, Iori Tachibana, in their 3rd year of middle school.

title: This Was in the Wallet of My Childhood Friend
description: Childhood memories. Feelings that pass through time.

title: 32 cm Height Difference
description:
This is the story of two very different girls.

With a 32 cm height difference, the length of their strides, their clothing sizes, and even the clubs they were encouraged to join were all different.

As Ritsu finds herself drawn to Uno’s cheerfulness, the distance between them gradually grows smaller.

title: Bakeneko Hazuki no Shimai Jijou
description: Sora is a primary school student when her favourite childhood friend, Hazuki, decides comes to stay with her.Also, Sora's parents are going on a long business trip, so she and her Hazuki "Onee-chan" are going to start living together! Sora is excited, but something is wrong with Hazuki... Wait, Something is seriously wrong with Hazuki! She is possessed by a monster cat! Against Hazuki's will, the monster cat tries to kill Sora! But somehow, she falls in love with Sora...? Ehh?! How did this happen?

title: Tsumugu Otome to Taishou no Tsuki
description: A Reiwa girl transferred into a women's school in Taishou!? Falling unconscious after an earthquake, when opening her eyes, Tsumugu astonishingly found her time traveling to Ginza in the year of Taishou 10(1921). Having nowhere to go, Tsumugu was helped by Itsuki, a duke's daughter, and she was suggested to transfer into Itsuki's school. How would Tsumugu's life become in a different timeline?

title: Fujoko to Yuriko
description: Two childhood friends, each with a secret. Fujoko's secret, she's a fujoshi. Yuriko's secret, she's in love with Fujoko. Will their love story start when Yuriko learns Fujoko's secret…? A love comedy between Yuri and BL.

title: Boku Girl Boyish-chan
description: Senpai, my girlfriend, who looks like a tomboy, is actually a bottom that gets easily horny.

title: Gal to Jimiko ga Koi wo suru Seishun Yuri Anthology
Ikkitousen
description:
Sealed in ancient jewels are the spirits of the heroes who tried and failed to unite China in the Three Kingdoms era. These jewels have been scattered throughout Japan, and have the power to draw out the full potential of those who inherit them. However, those owners, known as Toushi, are possessed with an insatiable appetite for battle. Hakufu Sonsaku is one such Toushi. Living in the country, Hakufu's desire to beat something to a pulp goes unfulfilled until her mother tells her to go to Tokyo, where she starts training with other Toushi and sets foot on the path to her destiny.
___
**Official English:** [emaqi](https://emaqi.com/manga/ikki-tousen) - United States & Canada only.

title: Mizuno and Chayama
description:
In a small town where "water (Mizu)", and "tea (Cha)" are its sole lifeblood, the conflict between a major tea plantation, and the "opposition" who claims the tea industry is polluting the water, continues to grow.  
  
There resides Mizuno, whose father leads the "opposition", and Chayama, a girl bullied by her classmates for being the sole daughter of the tea plantation. Backgrounds barring them from even talking, they rendezvous behind closed curtains…  
  
  
Alternate summary:  
||Mizuno, a high school girl in an isolated province. While worrying about her father's mayoral election campaign, she also has to keep up with her studies and socializing. But she has a secret she can never reveal to anyone: at a given time, at a given place, she meets with another girl. When they meet, they tease each other, and yet she remains Mizuno's beloved.||

title: Kimochi Warui kara Kimi ga Suki
description: Tsukasa, who falls in love with her best friend Yoriko, hides her feeling and continues her daily life. In the meantime, Yoriko also seems to have deep affection to Tsukasa.

title: Assault Lily: League of Gardens -full bloom-
description:
When the enigmatic life-forms called the Huge appeared, they nearly brought the world to ruin. But humanity studied the energy called magie and created CHARMs, potent weapons against the Huge. 

Teenage girls, who proved to resonate the most with CHARMs, became the vanguard in the war with the Huge. There is a name for these girls who fight against humankind's end. They are known as elegant flowers of battle—as Lilies.

A manga adaptation of the stage play "Assault Lily: League of Gardens."

title: Hare no Kuni no Apparedan
description: After moving to Okayama, Momozaki Koharu met a splendid trio that called themselves friends of Momotaro. Because she has "momo" (peach) in her name and had a kibi dango with her, Koharu was recognized as Momotaro (by the group). In order to protect the peace of Okayama alongside them, they went to an amusement park, participated in a festival and many other things… isn't that just playing around?! A relaxing life of Okayama stories begins♪

title: The JK Looks Like a Novelist!
description: At her high school entrance ceremony, Hibino Yuika meets the pretty Hoshizawa Nabi who… looks like a novelist?

title: A Transfer Student With Glasses Who is Surprisingly Strong
Himitsu no Recipe
description: The president of the cooking club helps one of the members with a dilemma.

title: Kage to Hana
description: Gekka Girls' High School is located in the hills west of Tokyo. The school is a traditional boarding school where no boys are allowed. All the female students attending this school are ninjas!

title: Modern Romanesco
description: The “Haunted School”, where countless mysterious incidents occur. The new headmistress of the school, Banseiin Nanako, and a demon hunter with four identities, Yasogami Ruru, team up and risk their lives to exterminate demons! An unstoppable horror action manga!!

title: Blood Time
description: The clumsy mistake maker, Yeon-Woo, one day passes through a dark alley and comes face to face with a person named Ha-Yang. To her surprise, the young woman appears to be a vampire, who asks for Yeon's blood in exchange. Will Yeon let the scary Ha-Yang taste a drop of her blood?

title: You Look Better Crying
description: Crybaby Xiao Yu together with the expressionless bad girl Xiao Xiao. Two different personalities seeking comfort in each other.

title: qtμt Cutie Mutie
description:
Hana was enjoying her peaceful days at school until she received a mysterious letter which said: "Do not say a word."…  
  
She doesn't know what to do, thus she begs for help of her friends to find out who is the sender and what is that she forgot she should be not saying..? But the truth is more terrifying than she expected.

title: Toki
description: A Saki spin-off series. It follows the characters Toki Onjouji, Ryuuka Shimizudani and other girls from Osaka during their elementary and middle school years.

title: Ohime-sama no Himitsu
description: The principal's valuable vase has been broken the school prince and volley-ball club ace, Fujiwara-senpai. "Don't tell anyone, I'll do anything you say!" Having witnessed the incident, Miu, on the spur of the moment, chose to go out with her senpai. Over the course of the dating, Miu became attracted to her senpai's surprising frankness, but by then, it was too late to say her true feelings. This is how she came to fall in love with her senpai. A bittersweet highschool romance.

title: The Rain and the Other Side of You
description: Yuka Kano, a 27-year-old junior high school teacher, has never dated a man in her life. One rainy afternoon, whilst tutoring one of her students, Yuka suddenly finds herself being kissed on the cheek by Aki Madarame. Aki confesses that in order to be alone with Yuka, she purposely failed the test. Confused as to why her student would do such a thing, Yuka decides to visit Aki at her house, where she finds out the ugly truth…

title: Tonari no Seki no Ko no Mousou ga Mieru Yuri Manga
The Young Lady and Her Lackeys Are Going to Pick on the Transfer Student
description: "She's too uppity, so let's put her in her place! Wait… why are you saying nice things to her? Oh, she's pissed! She's gonna hurt yo… oh…"

title: Girls in the Hell
description:
A twisted yuri anthology by Kawai Rou.  
  
Contents:  
1) Lilism Kyōsōkyoku (Lilism Frenzy)  
2) My Little Red Riding Hood  
3) Shota Girl  
4) Nisemono Drop (Fake Drop)  
5) Boseki ni Love Song (A Love Song for a Tombstone)  
6) Lovely Melanchloy Distortion  
7) Girls in the Hell  
8) Ama Koji de Tamagoyaki (Ama Koji Omelettes)  
9) Mahou ja Tabako wa Kaemasen (Magic Can't Buy Cigarettes) (<https://mangadex.org/title/39431/magic-can-t-buy-cigarettes>)  
10) Momo ga Waruin Dakara (This is Your Fault, Momo)  
11) Watashi wa Nee-san to wa Chigau Dakara (I'm Different From You, Nee-san)  
12) Tatoeba, Eien Nantemono ga Nakatta toshite (What If Nothing Was Forever)

title: Ayame and Amane
description: A short (2-3 pages bimonthly) gag manga about two best friends, one of whom (Ayame) is in love with the other (Amane). Each chapter follows the hijinks of Ayame's advances towards Amane, which usually end up in comedic failure.

title: Sukeban to Tenkousei ga Kudaranai Asobi o Suru dake no Hanashi
description: The transfer student regularly asks the bully to read a few cute little words out loud. And that's... cute? Yes, definitely cute.

title: Kitanai Kimi ga Ichiban Kawaii: Sou Ieba Sonna Koto
Kanojo ga Onii-chan ni Nattara Shitai 10 no Koto
description: As a result of entering high school, Nanase moves into a sharehome. Only, there is a special rule that states "all the residents must be assigned a family role"!! What will happen of Nanase's life as she starts living with her pretend family...!?

title: Shin Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei - Cygnus no Otome-tachi
description: Follows two girls named Arisa and Marika. Though raised as sisters, Arisa is one day entrusted to the elite Jumonji magical family, separating them for two years. Now, both are enrolled at First High School, and finally reunite.

title: After Transmigrating into a Book, I Snatched the Role of the Supporting Male Character
Onaji Pantsu
description: A girl who is overlooked and ignored in the class discovers quite by accident that the cool beauty who is adored by the rest of the class has something common with her, something very intimate.

title: Boring
description:
Sunday Battle 8 No. 45, Oneshot Theme: Rage.

A feisty girl isn't too fond of her childhood friend being so fixated on doing manga with others.

I'm supposed to be enjoying my happy school life where I get confessed to by a new girl every day, but I actually have a problem: my unfulfilled first love. But even that should be no problem for me now! My rematch to fix my mistakes and fulfill my first love has begun!!...or so I thought?! title: Tsubomi
description:
Was a bi-monthly yuri anthology published by Houbunsha.

The magazine started in 2009 and ran until 2012, sitting right at that point in yuri manga history where creators turned away from the pure, hierarchical, class S romances of earlier yuri toward the variety of yuri stories of today. It ran alongside Yuri Hime and the now also defunct Comic Hirari and stood in stark contrast to shoujo and josei romances of the day.

Its short run produced a number of classic yuri manga, including Higashiyama Shou's Prism, Arata Iri's Comprehensive Tovarisch, Notes from the Garden of Lillies, Kurogane Ken's Hoshikawa Ginza District, and Morinaga Milk's The Secret Recipe. Apart from the classics, the magazine included all sorts of, at the time, genre-defying yuri, including historical works, coworker, college, giant robot, and adult life stories, bi characters that weren't a toxic mess, and enough angst and drama to fuel the genre for a decade!
