title: Soul Eater Not!
description:
Soul Eater Not! focuses on a freshman halberd named Tsugumi Harudori, who befriends two other meisters, Meme Tatane and Anya Hepburn. One girl in her class, Sendo Yuki, is different from the others. She rarely speaks or interacts with the other girls in the class, and Akari finds her intriguing. After she follows Yuki during lunch one day, Akari sees a whole other side of her, one that is fascinated with cameras and photography.

As she observes the young women of her town, she learns more about their desires, their struggles, and the unpredictable whims of love.

title: Kissing Lilies

title: Nekonome Yuuka wa Kataru Bekarazu
description:
Seirin Academy, a famous academy with a long history, is one of the leading places of education for young ladies far and wide. It is also place where Tsujiura Mio just transferred to, and somewhat... strange. Seirin Academy has a number of taboos, one of which is getting involved with the upperclassman Nekonome Yuuka, someone Mio can't help but be drawn towards. And when Mio does start interacting with Yuuka, she begins getting caught up in all sorts of inexplicable occurrences, after all, Nekonome Yuuka _is not alive_.

So, who, or what, is Nekonome Yuuka? And what secrets are hidden away in the hallways the dainty young ladies of the Academy walk down every day?

title: Yuri Yuri
description:
Missed connections + misunderstandings + misperceptions = happy ending. 
From Namori, the creator of the laid-back yuri sensation Yuru Yuri, comes another slice of life of the Namori World. This complete collection includes all five volumes of the old school yuri shoujo doujinshi Yuri Yuri, plus Yuri Yuri After~, depicting the aftermath of volumes 1-4. Do you remember your first love ー that fluttering heart, the confusion, the frustration?

Tenman Sora has fallen in an unrequited love for the Railway Club's Mahiro-sensei!

'It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a high school girl in possession of dog ears, must be in want of a (spoiler).'  
  
In the not too distant future, when living animal ears can be transplanted to people, dog crazy Hikari has a pair of dog ears and has convinced her beloved Inukai-senpai to get a pair as well. But there may be side effects…  
  
This is the same world as Usa-bility and Mimi Mix! and we're back to girls dating girls. As always, it's complete fluff and super cute.

title: Coming Across a Beautiful New Teacher Having A Forbidden After-School Scene With a Student...?!
Yagate Kimi ni Naru (Webtoon)
description:
Yuu has always loved shoujo manga and awaits the day she gets a love confession that sends her heart aflutter with bubbles and blushes, and yet when a junior high classmate confesses his feelings to her… she feels nothing. Disappointed and confused, Yuu enters high school still unsure how to respond. That's when Yuu sees the beautiful student council president Nanami turn down a suitor with such maturity that she's inspired to ask her for help. But when the next person to confess to Yuu is Nanami herself, has her shoujo romance finally begun?

Except for one thing, "I can not forgive liking anyone." After several years, Yume reunites with her childhood friend, Yukino, who supports her dream. Three people's past, secrets, twisted and and stagnated… a story about distorted love and "a girl who can not like anyone."

title: Classmate de Yuri Mousou Shiteru Tomodachi
Candy Boy
description:
Based on the popular yuri OVA series, which is about the relationship between two fraternal twins and their daily life.  
  
Yukino and Kanade continue their schooling, and Kanade takes a late night art class in preparation for her future.   
As before, she usually ends up fooling around and drawing her sister in strange poses before finally getting her work done.   
Kanade begins to question the feelings she has for Yukino… does she feel a pure sisterly love for her, or are her feelings more perverted?

Riri, a high school girl who can see other people's likability, enjoys observing people.
Every day she enjoys the changes in human relationships from a step back... that was supposed to be the case! But when her friend Hiiro confesses her feelings for her, she gets caught up in a complicated (?) relationship...!

description: Yuuri Hirano had promised a girl during her childhood that she would kiss her when she reached her marriage age. Thinking this was just a joke, she, however, met that girl again on the first day of high school.

description: One day, Miharu - a plain and seemingly honor student - is approached by Fujii Yua, a 'gyaru' from the class next door. She gets closer with Yua, but, Miharu has a secret hobby… An easy-going GL about idols and 2 totally opposite high school girls.

title: Mayu, Matou
description: Clad in school uniforms practically breathing with life are the girls of Hoshimiya Girls' Academy. When a certain “incident” rocks the academy, hidden feelings will be entwined in this pure girls' love story.

Yukari is a “bad girl.” She rebels against her controlling mother by dyeing her hair, polishing her nails and having an older boyfriend. Miki is a “good girl.” She’s tall, quiet and smart. And a bit aloof.  
  
The two are forced to share a double desk at the beginning of the term which annoys Yukari no end. Yukari’s initial reaction is disdain and derision for Miki’s behavior. But, one day, after school, she sees Miki in the Art Room, gently kissing a statue of Mars and her heart starts to race. When someone comes up from behind, both Miki and Yukari know that they’ve been seen, and everything changes between them.

Akane, who's always longed for a fateful encounter like in shoujo manga, has entered a prestige all-girls high school, ran into a beautiful upperclasman Iori and fell in love on first sight. Wanting to get closer to her, Akane joins the student council, but how will she approach the flawless Iori-senpai?
A school yuri starring a heroine reject fantasizer girl and a perfect senpai who's always on her guard!

While her classmates treat her like she’s disturbed for talking to herself, Kagari stays by her side, protecting her and telling her over and over again how much she loves her. However, what Kagari understands as “love” is far from human, and little by little, Ageha begins to lose the ability to distinguish between the people and the strange creatures surrounding her.

A student at an all-girls school, Yuna, suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts, and meets the ghosts of two ill-fated lovers who are stuck in her school because they died without fulfilling their love. Chizuru Yoshida is not your typical high schooler and she's all too aware of it! She has a talent with getting what she wants from her male lovers and often comes across as cold and manipulative…  
  
In truth, despite her experiences with guys, she has never been in love. That's until the fateful arrival of newly-trasferred student, Azumi Yamada, at her school. It was love at first sight for Chizuru–indeed an unexpected turn of events for the story's vixen!  
  
Not only was she in love, but with all things…another girl. Chizuru goes through a brief stage of anger and denial and tries to convince herself that she couldn't possibly be attracted to such a simple-looking, shy, and naive girl! To her despair she finds herself constantly thinking of Azumi, so she finally resolves to become friends with her, but it's not too long when she starts to push things along with Azumi…

description: Be careful with uniform buttons.

title: Yubisaki ni Koi wo Sakasete
description: To Saki, Koiro has been her long-time friend since grade school, and someone she deeply admires. After having her nails painted by Koiro to match her, she returns home and thinks back...

title: Holy Girl Paradigm
description: Paradigm Girls Academy, a famous catholic combined middle and high school. Not interested in love, Aoi hopes a school life among the virtuous Ojou-sama would turn her into a graceful and high-class lady herself. Riri thought joining a girls’ school would allow her to finally find love. Bonding over having their dreams meet a harsh reality, a beautiful friendship(?) begins.

title: Girl in the Birdcage
description: Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi’s charms, Yumi’s got a hidden agenda.

title: Watashi ga Motenai no wa Dou Kangaetemo Omaera ga Warui! - MokoMote (Doujinshi)
Yankee×Jerky
description: Delinquent girl Aira Onizuka is skipping class at the back of the school building as usual.  Ruu Ookami, who is in the same class as her, comes to see her. Ruu is a werewolf, a species that can change its form into a wolf! Ruu said she came wanting to thank her for the jerky she gave her when she was a wolf, but…! Two lone wolves meet, a girls' romantic comedy with both having a crush on each other!

title: Watashi wo Hitorijime ni Shite
description:
Two short stories by Kaneko Aru  
  
1. Himitsu to Mitsumete:  
"I will treasure this forever" - classmates Hina and Mitsuki are secretly dating. Hina wants to have the popular Mitsuki all to herself, as a present she gave Mitsuki and herself matching keystraps. When Mitsuki touched the keystrap, she felt something hard within it. This is… a wiretap!?  
  
2. Kawarukoto:  
Months and years pass by and various things change between them. But, some things didn't change. A story of two students who are childhood friends.

title: Kuchidome Ryou Cider
description: Fuji, the class president, was angry at Tachibana, a gyaru in her class who never listens to her. Because of this, Fuji decides to relieve her stress by smelling Tachibana's gym clothes, only to be interrupted by Tachibana herself during the act. How will Tachibana react, and what will Fuji do?

title: Techno Panic Universe
description:
In a desperate bid to save the "Hashidate University High-Dimensional Engineering Laboratory" from closure, the genius—and stunningly beautiful—Professor Enri Nagisawa races across campus in search of new recruits. She soon joins forces with three eccentric girls—an "Android from Outer Space," a "Mecha-Obsessed Disciplinary Committee Member," and a "Masochistic Heiress"—and together, they transcend the bounds of reality to do whatever they please!

"Even if you're an outcast, you're never alone."

Get ready for a sci-fi Yuri comedy that’s mostly side-splittingly funny—with just a few moments that might bring a tear to your eye!

title: Sunshine & Bright Stars
description: Realistic and nuanced slice of school life. A cute, positive, and enthusiastic junior bumps into a girl who does hip-hop, and is emotionally shy and slow despite looking cool. The sweet, tangled-up, heartwarming, and GL story of chasing love.

title: Rin to shite Karen na Hana no you ni
description: Childhood friends Isuzu Rin and Yuuki Karen are always together, but every time they open their mouths they get into a fight…. But they are connected by a secret. In truth the two are fighting day and night against a enemy - the Fatals - beings that manipulate emotions to drive people into despair. But now there's a mysterious transfer student, an enemy that knows the secret of Rin's body, and someone at school has taken an interest in Karen?! With many ups and downs, the stylish action duo Rin and Karen begin their story!

title: Imouto ga Dekimashita.
description:
Collection of Stories:  
  
1. I Got Myself a Little Sister (Imouto ga Dekimashita):  
Azusa-chan's mother remarried and Azusa is worried about whether or not her new younger sister will like her.

2. Graduation Day (Sotsugyou no Hi)

3. And Then, the Two of Us... (Soushite Watashitachi wa)

4. The One I Love part 1 (Watashi no Suki na Ano Ko no Koto)

5. The One I Love part 2 (Watashi no Suki na Ano Ko no Koto)

6. My Beloved Kawano-san (Watashi no Aisuru Kawano-san)

7. Tayuminaku Ikiyo

description: Sebuah cerita tentang asrama perempuan di mana setiap siswa mengambil nama dari salah satu konstelasi zodiak.

description:
Yui, a freshman, is light-hearted.  
Miu, a freshman, is a bit out of control.  
Momoka, a freshman, is suspicious and somewhat scary.  
  
The three of them love Saori-senpai so much.  
  
Tankoubon version of 「Senpai 4koma」

title: Blue
description: Kayako Kirishima is almost ready to go off to college but is lonely and unsure of her future. Masami Endo is a girl who has been ostracized and made a social outcast for having an abortion. The two girls meet each other in class one day and become good friends. Gradually Kirishima falls in love with Endo and the relationship becomes more personal.

title: Houkago Nijigenme!
description: A girls' club for pursuing the cuteness of girls, known as "Love Club", engaged in fierce debate day after day! "Ane vs Imouto", "School swimsuit vs bikini"… etc. confrontations between members Aoi and Ouka, representing each faction! Aimi and Yumi forced to act as demonstrations against their will!? Plenty of fanservice and exposure, big tits and flat chests, please enjoy this cheerful school comedy!

title: A Day in the Lives of a Gyaru Couple - Lunch Break
description: A day in the lives of a gyaru couple.

After a heartbreak, a girl say yes to every girl confessing to her.

One day, she meets her Chérie at her school's infirmary.

title: 100 Ways to Kill a Seal
description: North Private Academy has a new transfer student. But Youko notices something strange…

title: Mousouzuki-chan to Haraguro Sensei
description: I'm Nagase Yukino, a high school student who loves having erotic fantasies about Kurosawa, the school nurse (female)! Until now, I've only been watching her from afar because she's too beautiful, but today, for the first time, I'll pretend to be sick to get closer to her! (Description taken from the website)

title: Bocchi the Rock! - BoKita ga Irekawaru Hanashi (Doujinshi)
description:
Circle MIX-ISM's "Bocchi the Rock!" Volume 3 is here!

One day, Bocchi-chan and Kita-chan suddenly swapped bodies!? They try to hide it, but their bandmates quickly catch on. The Gotou family is also perplexed by Hitori-chan (who is Kita-chan), who's suddenly so outgoing.

This body-swap comedy is full of slapstick humor and even a little bit of lewd content!

title: Joshikou no Ouji-sama to Osananajimi no Jimiko-chan
description:
A story about an orthodox Prince(girl) of a girl's only high school and her childhood friend(plain looking). Don't you agree that plain looking girls who are actually strong willed are really moe???

By the way, the plain girl's full name isn't featured, but it's Tanaka Mitsuru-chan.

PS: This work is a part of YuriComi 2021: https://www.pixiv.net/en/tags/%E3%83%A6%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B3%E3%83%9F2021/artworks

title: Tenshi no Drop
description: Botan Ichige has just enrolled in St. Asmaria All-Girl's School where angels are said to live. It turns out that angels do indeed live there, and after an accident, an angel named Un offers Botan her halo as a snack. After eating it, Botan discovers it had some bizarre side-effects, causing her to regularly "give birth" to colorful mushrooms. Is this the life of an angel!?

title: Steps
description:
Ah-chan and Ryouko, childhood friends eight years apart, are now teacher and student. Though Ryouko wants to rush into things, Ah-chan can’t take one step beyond her role as a teacher. After receiving a matching cellphone charm as a present, Ah-chan buys paired rings for a return gift, only to realise that she’s lost the charm…!?  
  
The distance between them shrinks away in “STEP UP”; a girl in love with Ryouko appears in “STEP FORWARD”; and then “step by step” calls for tears of joy with wedding dress x wedding dress… The road to love between Ryouko and Ah-chan is bountiful.  
  
Also included are “Leave hickey?”, about the radiant proof of love school girl Kimu carves into the body of the art teacher Miyano-sensei; and “secret love”, not previously published in a commercial magazine!

title: How To Stop a Hiccup
description: A girl helps her friend with her hiccup.

title: Hidan no Aria AA
description: A young girl idolizes the world-renowned S-ranked butei Kanzaki H. Aria and plans to follow in her footsteps. However, her test grades her out as only an E-rank! All is not lost, however, as Aria agrees to give her some pointers. Can Aria help this newcomer become a first-rate butei?

description:
A collection of Ohsawa Yayoi's one-shots from Yuri Hime.  
  
1. Koigokoro Metronome  
A story about Kawai-san taking music classes to be together with the senpai she loves. The problem is that her life is made unbearable by the sullen and strict drummer Ichibashi-san.  
  
2. Wagamama Fuzz to Pikapika-san  
  
3. Double Bind  
  
4. in secret…?  
  
5. Koiiro Etude  
After the incident where Kawai saw her senpai have feelings for another girl and broke down, Ishibashi has been unusually nice to her. Kawai decides to confront Ishibashi about it, to let her know that she doesn't have to force herself to make Kawai feel better.

title: Till She Met Her
description: Every day is a romantic comedy. A silly love story between a spoiled succubus and a young maiden.

title: Hareta Hi no Dress Code
description:
If only I could wear my favorite clothes however I want...

Natsuki Yonei, a first-year high school girl, thought about wear slacks to school, but she ended up going with the "safe" option of a skirt instead. But she notices another girl, Miwa Omi, who is wearing pants, even though almost all the other girls are wearing skirts. Intrigued, Natsuki tries to befriend her, and she learns the reason why Miwa doesn't wear skirts...

*Source: Ichijinsha, translated*

description: Mikoto Yuuichi (called witch due to a similar sounding surname) is the student council president and is constantly courted by a girl named Naitou.

title: Koi ni Wazurai
description: Scandal: Hashimoto Misaki is a member idol group Lily-Puri. Her girlfriend, Nagisa, thinks that Misaki might be too close with one of her members, Ayame. Furthermore, a magazine has been trying to break a scandal about Misaki. The magazine eventually gets just the scoop they need that puts the pair's relationship in jeopardy.

title: Yuri Danshi
description: Hanadera Keisuke is obsessed with yuri, and he's read all the Yuri Hime manga. However, he is sadly aware that there is one thing a lesbian romance absolutely does not need– him. One day, a student named Akane transferred to his class from an all-girls school. She used to go to school with another classmate, Saori, and Akane immediately tried to pick up their friendship. However, her clinginess, desire for alone-time, and intensity all convinced Keisuke that he was finally seeing yuri in reality! Soon enough, Keisuke had stalked them enough to see a love triangle between Saori, newcomer Akane, and their standoffish classmate Matsuoka. Is there truth to his observations, or is he viewing the world through yuri-tinted glasses?

title: Yamanko!
description: Though it was a bit strange, three people ended up meeting. One, who looks younger than her age and able to see the supernatural. Another who is possessed by a "Yamanko" which refers to "Yama no ko", or a mountain child. She was possessed due to her bloodline and due to the possession, she has superhuman abilities which she can call upon. Finally, an awkward person who enjoys writing poems. Coincidentally, the three are also classmates.

title: No Dignity for the Captain
description:
Kinosaki Emu, captain of the table tennis club, is a large-breasted high schooler who loves table tennis even if she’s bad at it.  
Opposite her is Yajima Esumi, her one-and-only club member, a sadist who’s amazing at table tennis. Esumi throws insult after insult at Emu like calling her a fat pig or only good for her boobs.  
Not sitting idly by, Captain wishes to restore her dignity. She gives her all in matches and tries to get new members to join the club. But will this be enough? Will Captain restore her dignity?

title: Mischievous Butterfly
description: Sakura, a 1st-year student at a music high school, loves playing piano. She also quietly loves her friend, Nanoha. Nanoha has adored listening to Sakura play the piano ever since they were children. As the yearly music competition for upperclassmen comes around, Sakura will have to deal with her passion for both the piano and Nanoha.

title: Game of Murder
description: Miki Fujisaki is a first year student whose obsession with murder frightens many of her peers. Student Council President Aoi takes it upon herself to scold Miki and set her right. But instead, Aoi is drawn into an increasingly elaborate game of "pretend-murder" with Miki that threatens her social status at school, and awakens new feelings deep within her.

title: Uniform and Parasol
description:
A girl of strong character in a school uniform, and a solitary figure under a dainty parasol. Across age and class, two lonely hearts thread together.

---
Part of the "青春18×2：重返最初的悸動" anthology

title: Hokenshitsu no Kagishimete
description: The secret pleasure of Notozawa Nadeshiko, the demure and conscientious head of the health committee, is checking the underwear of the pupils who visit the infirmary?! As the first friend of the new transfer pupil, Aichigawa Ikumi, Nadeshiko tells her about her secret love of underwear. For the sake of friendship (?), Ikumi tries to oblige. Today, too, their friendship blossoms in the infirmary, just the two of them…?!

title: LL Sister
description:
Konakai Futaba loves her older sister more than anything else in the world. Kind, beautiful and intelligent, Ichina was everything that Futaba wished that she could be… she even encouraged Futaba when she was feeling down.  
  
As such, Futaba went to the same highschool as Ichina, hoping to be reunited after two whole years of being apart…  
  
…but sadly, Ichina has completely changed from the sweet, gentle sister that Futaba remembers.

title: I Was Asked "Wanna Have Sex on Sunday?" and Was Horny For an Entire Week
Sakuran Bocchi
description: Sakura, a girl who has difficulty making friends. Kayo, a girl belonging to a literature club of which she is the only member. Yuri, a girl who seems to have a kind of one-sided rivalry with Sakura. Koyuki, a girl with a rather quiet character. These girls with totally different personalities unexpectedly cross paths when all four join their school's literature club!

title: Tada-san wa Kawaii
description:
"Tada Satsuki, she's a popular handsome girl who is kind, cool, and... cute?!"

A short story of girls love comedy between a cool handsome girl and a cute dork who adore her secretly.

(Published in Comic Yuri Hime Magazine November Issue 2022, as honorable mention of Yuri Hime 27th Comic Awards)

title: Kimi ga Deneb ni Hikaru Made
description: Raika, who loves helping people, and Atori, who adores musicals, are childhood friends. Since they were little, the two of them would put on plays just for each other, with no audience. Raika always thought that Atori's acting was impressive. Raika thought that if Atori loved it so much, she should join the drama club. But Atori wouldn't hear of it, saying, “Raika isn't in the drama club,” and “It's enough that Raika watches me.” Then, due to certain circumstances, Atori ends up taking the stage.

title: Shoujo Shikkaku
description:
A mysterious transfer student arrives to the third year, class C for Hanazono Girl's Middle School.  
Akane is a plain and simple girl who was tired of her overbearing friends, and silently thinks that it would be okay if the world were destroyed. One day, all the girls of the class awake to find themselves in a deserted school, with mysterious timers counting down. Each girl is shackled to another girl, and these pairs must work together to survive a 7-day Battle Royale. As it turns out, Akane is paired with the mysterious transfer student.  
  
Friendships crumble, hopes are lost, and sanity is tested as the game starts off with a bang!

As she thinks about the best way to break up with him, an unknown woman invites her to sing some karaoke. Is she hitting on her, or just looking for a friend? title: YuruYuri & Pokémon - Something about YuruYuri and Pokémon (Doujinshi)
description:
One day at school, the Amusement Club pick up an odd game cartridge and suddenly find themselves transported to the world of Pokémon! They're trying their best to get home with the help of their newfound Pokémon, but will their adventure be as laid-back as their official story? Can they survive in this new world? Can Akari manage to catch her first Pokémon!?
  
A crossover between Yuru Yuri and Pokémon with over 700 pages originally published at <http://www.geocities.jp/manzyu2003/yurumon.html>  
  
With Geocities closure, the author has migrated the series to <https://www.pixiv.net/user/929540/series/54941>

title: Each Other's Guardians
description:
Trained fighters known as Bastioners battle against invaders from another world using a mysterious power called Aegis. Aegis can grant people and objects tremendous strength, but people are unable to use it on themselves and must therefore always fight in pairs to give each other power.  
  
Yorino Aratsugu and Yoko Kaminoi are two young girls training to become Bastioners. Yorino used to protect the timid Yoko from bullies, but now Yoko has surpassed her at everything other than combat skills. As the two of them become full-fledged Bastioners, Yorino must fight to keep herself from becoming fully eclipsed by Yoko's talents, while also struggling to understand the more complicated feelings she has for her childhood friend.

description:
1. Makuai Curtain Call  
  
2. Ijiwaru no Susume

We met by coincidence, but I want to see you again.

Sumika and Hanano have just recently become lovers. In an attempt to get closer, Hanano invites her senpai/lover to her house for a sleepover. The two are nervous and conscious of their movements since they don't want their true intentions with the sleepover to be revealed.  
  
6. Good Morning Eve  
  
7. Sore wa, Ashita kara.

title: Chou Shin-Uchuu Yori Ai wo Komete (oneshot)
description: Lulu, an alien princess from outer space, suddenly appears in front of the high school girl Ten Teradate. Ten is told that she has been chosen to be Lulu's companion, and the two begin to live together. At first, Ten felt confused about the situation, but gradually she is moved by Lulu's heartfelt feelings...

title: Gin Shio Shoushou
description: On the day of the high school entrance, standing in front of beautiful sakura trees, Siro heard someone asking: "May I take a photo?" Thinking that person wanted to take a photo of the flower, Siro agreed and stepped back, but suddenly that person pressed down the shutter!

title: Sugar wa Otoshigoro
description:
Hatanaka Keiko's an odd girl with odd aspirations (I mean, REALLY weird), but she tries her best to fit in with the other girls in her class… She still sucks at it, though.  
  
One day, she meets Asami, a girl who's even more of an outcast than she is–but unlike Keiko, Asami's own "outsider" status doesn't seem to bother her in the slightest.  
  
As they grow closer, what's going to happen to Keiko's standing among the other girls? And what about Asami's own issues?

Amako is a 15-year-old girl with a sweet tooth who just enrolled into high school. Her family has had to move around since she was a child because of her dad's job, so she doesn't have any close friends. However, they don't have to move anymore, so Amako hopes that she'll finally have a regular school life with lots of friends. However, when she goes to join the tea ceremony club, she finds that it has been abolished for lack of members.  
  
Alone in the tea ceremony room, Amako opens a new cup of pudding and is shocked to find a girl named Pudding appear out of it, who says she's a princess from the Kingdom of Sweets. Pudding has run away from home because she wanted to study abroad, and in exchange for letting her stay at Amako's house, Pudding joins the tea ceremony club. In this series Himeko is a nun who leds a peaceful but lonely life, having lost both her parents and her beloved older sister.  
  
One day she finds a girl hung inside the church, impaled by a sword. The girl, who strongly resembles Himeko's dead sister, is still alive and calls Himeko's name. She reveals that her name is Chikane, but she has a memory loss about everything else.  
  
From that moment, Himeko starts to be targeted by a group of people who want to obtain the "Dragon Cry", which is said to be hidden inside her body. Chikane (after trying to know Himeko "more intimately") vows to protect her.

title: Cutie Honey
description:
Honey Kisaragi is a normal catholic schoolgirl. 

That is, until her father was murdered by the Panther Claw who were seeking the Airborne Elemental Fixation Device. 

She then finds out that she is actually an android created by him with the Airborne Elemental Fixation Device within her. She is now trying to live a life as a normal schoolgirl and seeking revenge against Panther Claw.

-- --
Originally meant as a magical girl series, but the timeslot the anime version was on was switched; therefore, it had to be changed for a 'shonen' demographic. Ultimately, Honey ended up being not a magical girl series (due to her transformation being based on science fiction, although because of multiple similarites Honey is often treated as part of the Toei magical girl lineup) but rather an early example of a series with a female lead that would have her exposed before and during battle for a male audience.

description: Hayase has gone to this school for years, so she knows that you do *not* touch anyone on Monday, and if you do, there's a little incantation that must be recited. But Mashiro has just transfered in, and does not know these things. Hayase explains that we do not touch on Monday, because not too long ago two girls did - and they fell in love, became lovers and tried to die together. Therefore, if you don't recite the charm, you might fall in love with whomever touched you…and that would be bad. Of course Hayase explains this after Mashiro has touched her…on a Monday.

title: Bosabosa Melancholy
description: Shion is anxious about having to find a new hairdresser to cut her hair, when suddenly a strange girl from an unknown hair salon calls out to her.

title: Gekouchuu ni Ame ga Futtekita Kara Kouhai no Kasa ni Irete Morattara...
Assault Lily: Last Bullet - Secret Garden ~ Dreamy Memoria ~
description: A slice-of-life anthology about what-if scenarios between the girls in a peaceful world.

title: Yuri Yuri (Doujinshi)
description:
A series of original doujinshi that Namori published under her circle ELEGY SYNDROME, each volumes contain several extra stories by various guest artists.  
  
Volumes 1-3 & 5, were done by Namori herself. The rest of these volumes are extra stories from other artists.

title: That Feeling's Name
description: Pixiv Oneshot

title: Yuri Seijin Naoko-san
description: Living with an alien was something Misuzu never imagined would happen, but when it does, you just have to roll with the punches. Naoko is from another world, but you wouldn’t think that since she looks just like another school girl. But her weird but pleasant personality and the advanced technology she has brought makes living with her anything but normal. Misuzu and her family make her feel part of the family and try to go about their daily lives.

title: All Hail Empress Her Majesty
description: Ming is a Year 5 primary school student who had a dull and meaningless school life in the worst class of the worst school in a declining heavy industry city. However one day his deskmate Hua became the class president and declared herself "Empress". The class now goes on a journey to fight against the old order made by adults.

title: Kawaisa Amatte Sukisa 100-bai!!
description: A compilation of yuri oneshots by Meno.

title: Watashi no Chiisana Ohime-sama
description: Soga Tsukihi had a childhood prince that she used to play with. Now at present time, she's a competitive highschooler who one-sidedly competes with Ouji Kanade, a popular girl in her class. After getting a little closer with Kanade, she happens to see her prince again.

title: The Otaku Girl and the Girl She's Dating
BanG Dream! - Momo's 's Bandori Single Image Compilation (Doujinshi)
description:
A collection of stand alone single page comics/images by Momomomomom  
  
Note: The genres may vary depending on the image.

title: Game
description:
1-3. Game  
A transfer student who's also a secret writer has a crush on a classmate lookalike who happens to be an artist, team up together.  
  
4. Nakushimono/Okurimono (Something Lost/Something Given)  
  
5. Acchi/Kocchi/Docchi (This Way/That Way/Which Way?)  
  
6. Kiss Chuchu  
  
7. Nani ka? Nani mo? (Something? Anything?)

title: Watashi ga Riaru de, Yuri Nante.
description:
I like yuri manga, but I can't be yuri in real life...

Konomi and Haru have been childhood friends since elementary school.

Haru and I are both otaku, and I took it for granted that we would be best friends forever. She has confessed to me over and over again, a whopping 106 times! I've had enough of this!

...Then I heard that my friend Kinu was dating a girl from another school.
I love yuri manga, but I can't imagine myself dating another girl in real life....

title: SAVING YOU
description:
A mysterious new student is sent over to a private academy for one important reason; to keep tabs on a certain group of girls. Loyal to the one who sent her, she is reluctant to get close to them. But to these girls, they see a potential new friend.

Deprived of a normal life, she slowly starts to live the life she secretly longed for: attending school, building friendships, and love... But will this bliss last forever?

title: Lucky☆Star - Comic à la Carte
description:
In the Lucky Star Comic a la Carte series:  
1) Happy Strike!   
2) Lucky Turn♪  
3) The Lucky Paira  
4) Brilliant☆Star

title: Lovers' Kiss
description:
When a rumor starts going around about Rikako and the school's notorious bad boy, Fujii, she decides 
they might as well make the rumors true. But things don't go exactly as planned and she starts developing feelings for him.
This two-volume series focuses on Rikako, her sister and their friends/classmates in a series of loosely-linked stories.

title: Hatsukoi Shimai
description: During a fateful visit to Tsunojo Girls' School, Chika Matsusato meets the girl of her dreams–cool upperclassman Haruna Kanzaki. Even though they spent only one short day together, Chika will never forget Haruna's kindness, and has made it her life's goal to study hard and get accepted into Tsunojo Girls' School so that they can be together. But will Haruna share Chika’s feelings…?

title: Long Time No See
description:
By Boomer Squad:  
  
While out shopping, Mo Xiaoxia runs into her high school sweetheart, Lin Han, on the street. A series of chaotic yet heart-racing memories slowly begins to surface in Mo Xiaoxia's mind – the story of the two girls.

title: Sentimental Dust
description: Ayu and Hitsuji have been friends since kindergarten, but when Hitsuji tries to take them a step further, Ayu panics. Trying to maintain the blurry boundaries of their friendship proves difficult however when she soon has to watch helplessly while Hitsuji is gravitating towards the new music teacher.

title: Netsuzou Trap Late Winter
description:
Hotaru disappeared for a while, but was brought back by Yuma and returned to school. Yuma’s friend invites Hotaru to have a meal, but Hotaru shows no interest. Her eyes only reflect Yuma…

This is the sequel to the final chapter of the manga "Netsuzou Trap-NTR-" which was serialized in the comic magazine "Yuri Hime" by Ichijinsha from February, 2014, to November, 2017.

title: Mahou Shoujo Madoka☆Magica - Anthology Comic
description: The anthology of the TV anime *Puella Magi Madoka Magica* is finally on sale! The covers are newly drawn by Aoki Ume! Here comes the supreme anthology comic where you can see Madoka and her friends again in all kinds of ways!

title: Wishing on the Moon
description:
"Wishing on the Moon," by Morinaga Milk, is another story in the series that began with "Even If We're Not Friends" and continued in "If I Kiss Her Ring Finger" and "Chocolate Kiss Kiss." Can Nana and Hitomi manage to balance their relationship with the other demands on their time?  
  
This is the last chapter published for Ichijinsha's Yuri Hime magazine, their story continues as a new serialization in Comic High!

title: Honey Crush
description: Mitsu is in love with Madoka, who doesn't even know she exists. Mitsu's pretty happy stalking Madoka, but is a little careless about it and, one day, she's hit by a truck and killed. But now she can REALLY stalk Madoka - and drive away all the boys - and girls - that show any special interest in her. Woo-hoo! Plus she gets to be there when Madoka changes clothes and bathes, etc. etc. Mitsu's pretty happy with the deal. Then transfer student Kyouko shows up, declaring that when they were kids, Madoka and she had promised to marry one another. Mitsu tries her best to scare Kyouko off, but Kyouko is actually able to see Mitsu and isn't about to be budged.

title: Sword World 2.0 - Little Sorcerer Mucs
description: A story of new adventurers in Raxia, a world created by swords. Surrounded by snowy mountains, the city of Nayimhiraugh is located in the middle of a highway, where adventurers and merchants stop by to trade, and the commercial district is full of activity as various races come and go. There is also an adventurers' training school in this city, and the protagonist, Mucs, attends the training school and spends her days training to become a full-fledged adventurer!

title: Woo is a dangerous Woo in the universe!
description:
女子高生・久遠空々梨（くどうくくり）は下校中、巨大隕石の落下に遭遇し、全人類は一瞬にして滅亡してしまう。
――が、目を覚ますと、そこはなぜか衝突の３日前。
混乱する空々梨に対し、従姉妹の非数値ヌル香（ひすうちぬるか）は
衝撃の事実をつきつける――。

普通の女子高生だった彼女が、実は星間諜報組織のエージェントだった!?
宇宙がヤバイ大活劇、堂々スタート!!

title: Hanaeui gil
description:
A story about teenagers at the end of their first decade, meeting various people and figuring out who they themselves are.  
  
[Author's Twitter](https://twitter.com/Eibe_u/media)  
[Author's YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCrjQqJK5YhLtp5iFxTaBsFQ)

title: She's a Cancer
description: The story about two girls who share a common fascination for astrology (or, the sign of cancer).

title: Maho Girls Pretty Cure!
description: Mirai Asahina is a 13-year-old girl who sees a mysterious object fall from the sky into the park nearby. Excitedly, she sets off with her beloved stuffed bear Mofurun to search the park. There she meets Riko, a young witch flying on a broom. Riko is from the magical world, and she's searching for a jewel called the Linkle Stone Emerald in the "No Magic" world. When Mirai, Riko, and Mofurun join hands, with the magic words "Cure Up RaPaPa!" they transform into the legendary Pretty Cure!

title: Himitsu.
description:
- A Passing Story  
A school doctor recounts a romance from her own school days.  
  
- Pink  
A love triangle. It's set in the same school as "A Passing Story."  
  
- Romance  
A couple from the same school as "A Passing Story" and "Pink."  
  
- Lover  
Continues "A Passing Story" story in the present.  
  
- Secret Love  
A girl deals with heartbreak.  
  
- Sigh  
Shiratori, now in college, despairs of ever finding love.

title: Midnight Juice and Witchpie
description: Right after graduating from kindergarten, Ai Truvion, a girl who was born with pink hair, gets a letter of invitation from the Croquansch Witch Academy delivered by a penguin with a pink cape. ‘A witch elementary school? I don’t know how to use magic. Do I have a special ability that I didn’t know I had?’ Ai’s parents hesitantly take her to the academy and there awaits for Ai a huge surprise…

title: Pastel Love: A Minimal Love Story
description:
This is an early version of Pastel Love, the author wrapped it up in a limited-edition book!
*read from left to right

title: Portrait Rights Advisory
description: On a beautiful day with sakura blossoming, Year 1 Bomi sits in an empty art room, painting her imaginary ideal person. Hmm, this person looks very similar to that Haeyoon! A cool, tall, athletic Year 3 senior. Haeyoon told Bomi that if she didn't draw to her satisfaction, Bomi will encounter a Portrait Rights Infringement! So Bomi kept on drawing...

title: Yuri☆Kome
description: Natural airhead Chiho Sakuranaga entered an all girl's high school due to a misunderstanding. Before the entrance ceremony she ran into a puzzling, but beautiful boy like girl. Later the school president smiles at her and she can't stop the sudden pounding in her chest. Though self-proclaimed straight thus begins her yuri life.

I am going to post a story that came to my mind. I don't know if that story will or will not continue (lol)

Yuri MayaKuro (Maya x Claudine) One-Shot Doujinshi

When she was very young Milk Ushijima saw a calf being born on television and was greatly moved.  
Now she's enrolled in Toto School of Veterinary Medicine, and she thought her campus life was going to begin, but unfortunately… it turns out she's a complete airhead!  
  
She's about to get caught up in the lives of the crazy characters that are her teachers and fellow students, and her journey's about to go wild!

Manaka loves animals and sports thick eyebrows. And last but not least: Nanami, a.k.a. Na-chan, will be found riding her bike to school. A cute and quirky world awaits for this lively cast!

Cat's Eye Hall is a mysterious shop that exists to guide lost hearts. If your heart is lost, follow a black cat and you might just end up here…

title: Laika, Pavlov, Pochihachikou
description:
A collection of six of Yotsuhara Furiko's short stories depicting the love between various girls.   
  
1. Laika, Pavlov, Pochihachikou  
Set in a university, with Yuriko, a girl of the jou-sama type, being followed around by her puppy-like female friend Koroku. While eating lunch one day, Yuriko overhears some malicious gossip and her ensuing bad temper leads her to take Koroku to a hotel, where she tells her to do whatever she likes…  
   
2. One Who Depicts Love  
  
3. Lip-Service Woman and the Impregnable Maiden  
Koyuki is known among her friends as a smooth talker, so her love confessions to Matsuri keep falling on deaf ears.  
  
4. A Crow with a Glistening Trinket in Her Jet-Black Feathers  
Oribe is surprised to meet her classmate Karatsu while browsing cutesy trinkets – who promptly flees the store when spotted. And Oribe soon finds herself in trouble when her love for cute things gets out of hand.  
  
5. Koibumi Miman  
  
6. Chopsticks

One day, her twin brother, Miki, whom she hadn’t heard from in a while, appeared before her, asking her to substitute for him in an all girls school as teacher. Maki then quit her job and cut her hair to take on Miki’s appearance. But what is waiting for her…?!

title: Kaichou to Fukukaichou
description: The student council president is gaga over the vice president, but her feelings may or may not be returned. In the meantime, it's up to the serious and by-the-book vice president to keep the flaky (but surprisingly effective) president on track.

description:
It is the morning after Claudine slept together with Maya in the latter's bedroom and, given that she only vaguely recalls last night's events, she begins to wonder if all she did with Maya was simply "sleep." [Yuri Doujinshi]  
  
Source Anime: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight

title: Shoujo Kageki Revue Starlight - Maya and Claudine in Hogwarts School Of Witchcraft and Wizardry (Doujinshi)

title: Snow & Sunflower
description:
One day, Inoue Himawari "Hima" accidentally met an albino girl called Tomoe Shiroyuki "Yuki". At first she was scared of Yuki's red eyes that usually fixed on her. With helps of her friends, Hima got closed to Yuki and finally fell in love with her, even if Yuki always showed that she's hiding some truth from her.

What happens when two nuns-in-training are discovered to be having a relationship with each other?

A romance blooms between two roomates in an all-girls' boarding school.

title: Mahou Ineko to Ibarahime
description:
Story 1:  
Sagimiya Makage is new to an all girls school and doesn't feel like she will fit in. However, at the entrance ceremony someone even more weird than Makage introduces herself as an actual witch doctor who is employed to help with the school's curse.  
Shrugging it off, Makage later on makes a good friend at the dorms who won't wake up from the curse! How will Makage help her friend, and what is the secret behind this curse anyway?

title: Body Warmth Communication
description: Madoka is in love with the girly manager of her basketball team, Yuma. As she's having more and more trouble keeping her feelings in check, Yuma does something that starts a fight between the two. Will their feelings overcome the fight…?

title: Kyou Ami!
description: The Amusement Academy in Kyoto, along with its traditional curriculum, teaches its students about game design, how to write graphic novels, and voice animation. Akabane Iori is a cute girl that mistakenly enrolls into game design school instead of pursuing her dream of being a graphic novel author. She tries to make the best of her situation, but with no knowledge or experience about gaming, Iori has a hard time. The two friends she makes, Hio Raina, a game programmer, and Kirino Sami take her deep down a niche otaku culture that may make forever change Iori.

title: ICEPOP

title: Bakejo! Youkai Jogakuen e Youkoso

A lively yokai schoolgirl four-panel story with a yuri flavor!

Miko (a human) is a little bit of a rascal who has enrolled in the high school that the upperclassman she admires attends. However, it turns out that the high school is a school for "monster girls" called "Yokai Girl's Academy" - a.k.a. "Bakejo"!
The unique, quirky, and yet adorable youkai schoolgirls lead a noisy, fun-filled life! This is an easy-going comedy that you can enjoy no matter where you read it!

description: ¡Una comedia escolar sobre una monja y muertos vivientes! Con el fin de eliminar los prejuicios contra ellos, la hermana Mari Sakimori fue enviada a la «Escuela Nocturna del bosque Memeno», donde solo asisten los no muertos. Sin embargo, desde el primer día, Mari se ve obligada a buscar el cuerpo de Nono, una zombi despistada. description:
Azami has always been attracted only to boys, especially the handsome Gwyn. Intelligent, sporty, attractive and just a little older than Azami, she's sure he would be an ideal boyfriend. Then, on the day Azami finally gets the courage to confess her feelings, everything she believes is suddenly called into question when she finds out that Gwyn is actually a girl!

Despite her initial shock at learning Gwyn's secret, Azami quickly realizes that love transcends gender, putting her feelings for Gwyn before her previous prejudices. But it turns out Azami isn't the only girl who's got her eye on Gwyn!
___
Azami is rigidly heterosexual and has been putting the handsome, smart, sporty Gwyn on a pedestal. However, when she finds out Gwyn is actually a girl, her prejudices are downplayed by love for Gwyn. That is also when Azami joins a tough competition as she is not the only girl to set eyes on Gwyn

Un giorno la sua amica Sayuki, iscritta al club di teatro, le propone di sostituire un'attrice per la recita scolastica, altrimenti sarà difficile vincere contro un altro istituto, ma lei non vuole accettare. Ultimamente però non va molto bene con la corsa, anche se si impegna tanto e le viene consigliato dal medico di prendersi un periodo di riposo e accettare la proposta dell'amica. Misono non sa cosa le aspetta nel futuro, l'unica cosa che sa,è che deve continuare a correre!

title: Futari Pocchi: Together Alone
description:
Kaoru Matsubara, a common girl, and Reiko Higaki, a girl from a zaibatsu family, are two girls who attend the prestigious Aisei Girls College. They are complete opposites in their upbringing and personalities, and can hardly stand each other. However, when their parents remarry, they become sisters! The two clash and quarrel, but gradually come to an understanding, and many complicated feelings begin to emerge as they develop a bond... Riyoko Ikeda delicately depicts the emotional turmoil of adolescent girls as they face the absurdities of the world on a journey that can only be embarked by the two of them alone!

Note: Also contains the one-shot Gomennasai: Ryoko Hagiwara, an elementary school girl, decides to stand up for Yasue Yamada, an impoverished girl in her class. Little did she know the harsh reality awaiting her... A work that frankly depicts class divide and privilege, and how children emulate the practices and discrimination of adults.

Despite the differences in shapes, sizes, and species, the beastfolk inhabiting this world live together in harmony, enjoying their everyday, normal lives together.
Meet, Kiji, a high school tigress, who has fallen in love with Inasa, a cat who is not only a different species, but an completely opposite personality type as well. The closer they grow, the more Kiji wants to tell her how she feels, but would that ruin their precious friendship?
After all, Inasa's romantic interests aren't necessarily limited to girls like her...

This romantic comedy between two beastfolk girls is sure to bring you back to the nostalgic days of your youth!

title: Rebelde El Comic
description:
Rebelde was a Mexican comic book series, published by now defunct Ka-Boom! Estudio, based on the telenovela of the same title. The comic was first published April 2006 and lasted only two issues due to conflicts caused by Ka-Boom's writers. Despite initial demand being high, the amateur writing team from Ka-Boom delivered the scripts for the first three issues months later than agreed, causing the art team trouble and also creating conflicts with Televisa's editorial representatives, which led to the cancellation of the title.

The series was advertised as being based on the style of Japanese manga, but it was only partially based on it.

description: Cuando Bea, una chica extrovertida, comparte habitación con ina, una reservada y sarcástica amante de la tranquilidad, sus vidas toman un giro inesperado. A través de estos cortos momentos cómicos y dramáticos, aprenderán a lidiar con sus diferencias y descubrirán que, aunque son opuestas, su conexión es más profunda de lo que imaginaron. ¿Qué pasa cuando quien menos esperaba se vuelve lo más importante para ti?.

title: Futsuu to Fuhen no Hi
description:
This is a book about UiSaki going on a date in their school uniforms.
Will a flustered Ui-chan and a Saki-chan who keeps getting pulled along be able to have a normal date...?

title: Saki - HPBD (Doujinshi)
description: Celebrations of both Hisa's (November 13th) and Mihoko’s (September 24th) birthdays.

title: Maria-sama ga Miteru - Watashi no Shiroi Bara (Doujinshi)
description: Cute little doujin about Shimako and Sei-sama.

title: Girls und Panzer - Hito Natsu no Ie (Doujinshi)
description: Andō estaba cometiendo allanamiento y Oshida se termina enterando eso a través del club de periodismo, esto terminará desencadenando una nueva relación de amistad y tal vez algo más.

description:
Uika x Saki doujinshi
*The story takes place after Episode 12

title: Yǔ Zhǐ Xīng Jiàng Shí
description: Uika Misumi x Sakiko Togawa

title: Kiss of Dawnlight
description:
「學姐……我想知道更多妳的事。」


一次回眸，讓姍姍的目光從此離不開光柔學姐。
一次快門，定格了眼前的畫面，也悄悄拉近了彼此的心。


光柔的美，令姍姍自慚形穢，卻又致命地吸引著她，
在情緒翻湧的瞬間，她私藏了光柔的唇膏……
懷揣著罪惡與自卑交織的秘密，
她在逐漸靠近的距離中，
窺見了光柔耀眼外表下，藏著讓人顫抖的傷。
唯美、悸動、令人心疼。
再近一點，就能交換真心嗎？

title: Ao to Shiro to Natsufuku
description: A SoraMashi doujin from [Izumi Kirifu](https://x.com/kirifu0127) released in Rainbow Flavor 35.

title: Anata wa Dare o Erabimashita ka
Hitomi no Photograph
description: Aihara Haruka moved to a small town in the middle of the second year in high school. Far from all the life she had in big cities, she wanted to start a blog. For content, she started taking pictures of the place in her daily life, but find it difficult. A girl gave her advice, and Haruka got invited to the photography club soon after. At first, she can’t say that she’s only taking pictures for her blog, but with them, she starts to realize the fun of doing photography and learns more about it.

title: Penganggu Cintaku
description:
Hubungan pertamaku, aku pikir akan dipenuhi dengan kebahagiaan saja.
Tapi… aku rasa pacarku lebih suka dengan “teman perempuan terbaiknya”…
Kesal, aku mencoba menggunakan aplikasi saran kencan AI bernama “Meddler.”
Dan dia bilang aku mudah dibujuk? Apakah ini benar-benar AI?

title: Girls und Panzer - Mari-sama no Kekkon Zenya (doujinshi)

title: The Green Between Us
description:
"Every first love grows in green."

A slow-burn yuri romance about youth, growth, and first love-the story I've always dreamed of creating.

I'm excited to finally share my first original long-form comic, the green between us.
- from the author 金呂 | Kim Lu @alcuzn.factory on Instagram

description: In a world of love, a REDACTED appears dictating every individual eyes. A story about two idiots falling in love and navigating a corrupted society. Will they be able to save themselves from this REDACTED?
